	return TooltipProps{
		Position: TooltipPositionTop,
	}
}

type tooltipPositionStyles struct {
	Tooltip string
	Arrow   string
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for tooltip position styles
var tooltipPositionMap = map[TooltipPosition]tooltipPositionStyles{
	TooltipPositionTop: {
		Tooltip: "bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2",
		Arrow:   "top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-t-gray-900 dark:border-t-gray-700",
	},
	TooltipPositionBottom: {
		Tooltip: "top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2",
		Arrow:   "bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-b-gray-900 dark:border-b-gray-700",
	},
	TooltipPositionLeft: {
		Tooltip: "right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 me-2",
		Arrow:   "left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-s-gray-900 dark:border-s-gray-700",
	},
	TooltipPositionRight: {
		Tooltip: "left-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ms-2",
		Arrow:   "right-full top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 border-e-gray-900 dark:border-e-gray-700",
	},
}

func tooltipLookupPosition(pos TooltipPosition) tooltipPositionStyles {
	return utils.Lookup(tooltipPositionMap, pos, tooltipPositionMap[TooltipPositionTop])
}

// Tooltip wraps content in a hover/focus-activated tooltip. Pure CSS for
// show/hide (group-hover/group-focus-within); a singleton script propagates
// aria-describedby to the focusable trigger for screen-reader support.
//
//	@display.Tooltip(display.TooltipProps{Text: "More info"}) {
//	   <button>Hover me</button>
//	}
templ Tooltip(props TooltipProps) {
	{{ id := utils.EnsureID("tooltip", props.ID) }}
	{{ pos := tooltipLookupPosition(props.Position) }}
	<div
		id={ id }
		data-tc-tooltip
		class={ utils.Class("group relative inline-flex", props.Class) }
		aria-describedby={ id + "-tooltip" }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		{ children... }
		<div
			id={ id + "-tooltip" }
			class={ "absolute z-20 hidden group-hover:block group-focus-within:block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md bg-gray-900 dark:bg-gray-700 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-white shadow-xs",
				pos.Tooltip }
			role="tooltip"
		>
			{ props.Text }
			<div class={ "absolute h-0 w-0 border-4 border-transparent", pos.Arrow }></div>
		</div>
	</div>
	@tooltipAriaScriptComponent(props.Nonce)
}

# ── feedback/alert.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package feedback

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// AlertProps configures an alert banner
type AlertProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Title       string
	Message     string
	Type        FeedbackType
	Dismissible bool
}

// DefaultAlertProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultAlertProps() AlertProps {
	return AlertProps{
		Type: FeedbackInfo,
	}
}

// Alert renders a full-width alert banner
//
//	@feedback.Alert(feedback.AlertProps{Title: "Error", Message: "Something went wrong", Type: feedback.FeedbackError})
//
// The ARIA role derives from Type: errors announce assertively
// (role="alert"); every other type reports politely (role="status") so a
// success banner is never read as an error by screen readers.
//
// The dismiss control markup is shared via utils.DismissButton; only the style
// classes differ from errorpage.ErrorAlert. JS behaviour is shared via
// utils.DismissScript().
templ Alert(props AlertProps) {
	{{ s := feedbackStyle(props.Type) }}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("rounded-md border p-4", s.Border, s.BG, props.Class) }
		role={ feedbackRole(props.Type) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<div class="flex">
			<div class="flex-shrink-0">
				@icons.Icon(feedbackIcon(props.Type), utils.Class("h-5 w-5", s.Icon))
			</div>
			<div class="ms-3 flex-1">
				if props.Title != "" {
					<h3 class={ "text-sm font-medium", s.Text }>{ props.Title }</h3>
				}
				<div class={ "text-sm", s.Text }>
					<p>{ props.Message }</p>
					{ children... }
				</div>
			</div>
			if props.Dismissible {
				@utils.DismissButton(s.BG, s.Text)
			}
		</div>
		if props.Dismissible {
			{{ nonce := props.Nonce }}
			if nonce == "" {
				{{ nonce = templ.GetNonce(ctx) }}
			}
			if nonce != "" {
				@templ.Raw("<script nonce=\"" + nonce + "\">" + utils.DismissScript() + "</script>")
			} else {
				@templ.Raw("<script>" + utils.DismissScript() + "</script>")
			}
		}
	</div>
}

// inlineMessage renders a compact inline status message with icon
templ inlineMessage(message string, colorClass string, role string, icon templ.Component) {
	<div class={ "mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm", colorClass } role={ role } aria-live="polite">
		@icon
		<span>{ message }</span>
	</div>
}

// InlineError renders a compact inline error message for forms
//
//	@feedback.InlineError("This field is required")
templ InlineError(message string) {
	@inlineMessage(message, "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400", "alert", icons.Icon(icons.ExclamationTriangle, "h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0"))
}

// InlineSuccess renders a compact inline success message
//
//	@feedback.InlineSuccess("Saved successfully")
templ InlineSuccess(message string) {
	@inlineMessage(message, "text-green-700 dark:text-green-400", "status", icons.Icon(icons.Check, "h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0"))
}

# ── feedback/circular_progress.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package feedback

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// CircularProgressSize controls the diameter of the ring.
type CircularProgressSize string

const (
	CircularProgressSizeSM CircularProgressSize = "sm"
	CircularProgressSizeMD CircularProgressSize = "md"
	CircularProgressSizeLG CircularProgressSize = "lg"
)

// CircularProgressProps configures a circular SVG progress indicator.
type CircularProgressProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	// Value is the percentage (0–100). Values outside the range are clamped.
	Value int
	// Size controls the rendered diameter. Defaults to md.
	Size CircularProgressSize
	// ShowLabel renders the numeric percentage in the centre.
	ShowLabel bool
	// Color overrides the progress arc colour (Tailwind stroke utility).
	// Defaults to text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-500.
	Color string
	// TrackColor overrides the background track colour.
	// Defaults to text-gray-200 dark:text-gray-700.
	TrackColor string
}

// DefaultCircularProgressProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultCircularProgressProps() CircularProgressProps {
	return CircularProgressProps{
		Size:       CircularProgressSizeMD,
		Color:      "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-500",
		TrackColor: "text-gray-200 dark:text-gray-700",
	}
}

// circularProgressSizeLookup maps size enums to Tailwind dimension classes.
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for circular progress sizes
var circularProgressSizeLookup = map[CircularProgressSize]string{
	CircularProgressSizeSM: "w-8 h-8",
	CircularProgressSizeMD: "w-12 h-12",
	CircularProgressSizeLG: "w-16 h-16",
}

// circularProgressStrokeLookup maps size enums to SVG stroke widths.
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for stroke widths
var circularProgressStrokeLookup = map[CircularProgressSize]float64{
	CircularProgressSizeSM: 8,
	CircularProgressSizeMD: 7,
	CircularProgressSizeLG: 6,
}

// CircularProgress renders a circular SVG progress indicator with an optional
// percentage label. The value is clamped to [0, 100].
//
//	@feedback.CircularProgress(feedback.CircularProgressProps{Value: 75, ShowLabel: true})
templ CircularProgress(props CircularProgressProps) {
	{{
		value := max(0, min(100, props.Value))
		strokeWidth := utils.Lookup(circularProgressStrokeLookup, props.Size, 7)
		radius := 50.0 - strokeWidth/2
		circumference := 2 * math.Pi * radius
		dashOffset := circumference * (1 - float64(value)/100)
		sizeClass := utils.Lookup(circularProgressSizeLookup, props.Size, "w-12 h-12")
		color := props.Color
		if color == "" {
			color = "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-500"
		}
		trackColor := props.TrackColor
		if trackColor == "" {
			trackColor = "text-gray-200 dark:text-gray-700"
		}
	}}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("relative inline-flex items-center justify-center", sizeClass, props.Class) }
		{ props.Attrs... }
		role="progressbar"
		aria-valuenow={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", value) }
		aria-valuemin="0"
		aria-valuemax="100"
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		} else {
			aria-label={ fmt.Sprintf("%d%% complete", value) }
		}
	>
		<svg class={ utils.Class("w-full h-full -rotate-90", color) } viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none">
			<circle
				cx="50"
				cy="50"
				r={ fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", radius) }
				stroke="currentColor"
				stroke-width={ fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", strokeWidth) }
				class={ trackColor }
			></circle>
			<circle
				cx="50"
				cy="50"
				r={ fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", radius) }
				stroke="currentColor"
				stroke-width={ fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", strokeWidth) }
				stroke-linecap="round"
				stroke-dasharray={ fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", circumference) }
				stroke-dashoffset={ fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", dashOffset) }
				class="transition-all duration-500 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none"
			></circle>
		</svg>
		if props.ShowLabel {
			<span class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
				{ fmt.Sprintf("%d%%", value) }
			</span>
		}
	</div>
}

# ── feedback/doc.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Package feedback provides user feedback components including alerts, toasts,
// loading overlays, and step indicators.
package feedback

# ── feedback/enums_go.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package feedback

// SpinnerSizeIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined SpinnerSize constants.
func SpinnerSizeIsValid(v SpinnerSize) bool {
	_, ok := spinnerSizeLookup[v]

	return ok
}

// ProgressBarSizeIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined ProgressBarSize constants.
func ProgressBarSizeIsValid(v ProgressBarSize) bool {
	_, ok := progressHeightLookup[v]

	return ok
}

// SkeletonVariantIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined SkeletonVariant constants.
func SkeletonVariantIsValid(v SkeletonVariant) bool {
	switch v {
	case SkeletonText, SkeletonTextShort, SkeletonTitle, SkeletonAvatar, SkeletonImage, SkeletonCard, SkeletonTableRow:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// StepIndicatorOrientationIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined StepIndicatorOrientation constants.
func StepIndicatorOrientationIsValid(v StepIndicatorOrientation) bool {
	switch v {
	case StepHorizontal, StepVertical:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

# ── feedback/loading.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package feedback

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/svg"
)

// SpinnerSize defines the size of a loading spinner
type SpinnerSize string

const (
	SpinnerSM SpinnerSize = "sm"
	SpinnerMD SpinnerSize = "md"
	SpinnerLG SpinnerSize = "lg"
)

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for spinner sizes
var spinnerSizeLookup = map[SpinnerSize]string{
	SpinnerSM: "h-4 w-4",
	SpinnerMD: "h-6 w-6",
	SpinnerLG: "h-8 w-8",
}

func spinnerSizeClass(s SpinnerSize) string {
	return utils.Lookup(spinnerSizeLookup, s, "h-6 w-6")
}

// SkeletonVariant defines the shape of a skeleton placeholder
type SkeletonVariant string

const (
	SkeletonText      SkeletonVariant = "text"
	SkeletonTextShort SkeletonVariant = "text-short"
	SkeletonTitle     SkeletonVariant = "title"
	SkeletonAvatar    SkeletonVariant = "avatar"
	SkeletonImage     SkeletonVariant = "image"
	SkeletonCard      SkeletonVariant = "card"
	SkeletonTableRow  SkeletonVariant = "table-row"
)

// SpinnerProps configures a loading spinner component
type SpinnerProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Size  SpinnerSize
	Color string
}

// DefaultSpinnerProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultSpinnerProps() SpinnerProps {
	return SpinnerProps{ //nolint:exhaustruct // intentionally minimal defaults
		Size: SpinnerMD,
	}
}

// Spinner renders a simple animated loading spinner
//
//	@feedback.Spinner(feedback.SpinnerProps{Size: feedback.SpinnerMD, Color: "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"})
templ Spinner(props SpinnerProps) {
	<svg
		class={ utils.Class("animate-spin motion-reduce:animate-none", spinnerSizeClass(props.Size), props.Color, props.Class) }
		xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
		fill="none"
		viewBox="0 0 24 24"
		if props.AriaLabel == "" {
			aria-hidden="true"
		} else {
			role="img"
		}
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		@svg.SpinnerSVG()
	</svg>
}

// LoadingOverlayProps configures a full-screen loading overlay
type LoadingOverlayProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Message      string
	ShowProgress bool
	Progress     int
}

// DefaultLoadingOverlayProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultLoadingOverlayProps() LoadingOverlayProps {
	return LoadingOverlayProps{}
}

// LoadingOverlay renders a full-screen loading overlay
//
//	@feedback.LoadingOverlay(feedback.LoadingOverlayProps{Message: "Loading...", ShowProgress: true, Progress: 45})
templ LoadingOverlay(props LoadingOverlayProps) {
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center", props.Class) }
		{ props.Attrs... }
		role="dialog"
		aria-modal="true"
		aria-label={ utils.Ternary(props.AriaLabel != "", props.AriaLabel, props.Message) }
	>
		<div class="bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-xl dark:shadow-black/20 p-8 max-w-sm w-full mx-4">
			<div class="text-center">
				<div class="mx-auto flex items-center justify-center h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 mb-4">
					@Spinner(SpinnerProps{Size: SpinnerMD, Color: "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"})
				</div>
				<h3 class="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white mb-2">{ props.Message }</h3>
				if props.ShowProgress {
					{{ clamped := max(0, min(100, props.Progress)) }}
					<div class="w-full bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-full h-2 mb-2">
						<div
							class="bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0"
							style={ fmt.Sprintf("width: %d%%", clamped) }
						></div>
					</div>
					<p class="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{ fmt.Sprintf("%d%%", clamped) }</p>
				} else {
					<p class="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Please wait...</p>
				}
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
}

// InlineLoading renders a compact inline loading indicator
//
//	@feedback.InlineLoading("Saving...")
templ InlineLoading(message string) {
	<div class="inline-flex items-center gap-2" aria-live="polite">
		@Spinner(SpinnerProps{Size: SpinnerSM, Color: "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"})
		<span class="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">{ message }</span>
	</div>
}

// Skeleton renders a pulsing placeholder for loading content
//
//	@feedback.Skeleton("text")
templ Skeleton(variant SkeletonVariant) {
	<div aria-busy="true" role="status" aria-label="Loading" class="contents">
		@skeletonBody(variant)
	</div>
}

// skeletonBody renders the visual placeholder without aria annotations, so
// SkeletonGroup can compose many variants under a single role="status"
// announcement instead of N+1 redundant "Loading" reads.
templ skeletonBody(variant SkeletonVariant) {
	switch variant {
		case SkeletonText:
			<div class="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none h-4 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded w-3/4"></div>
		case SkeletonTextShort:
			<div class="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none h-4 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded w-1/2"></div>
		case SkeletonTitle:
			<div class="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none h-6 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded w-1/2"></div>
		case SkeletonAvatar:
			<div class="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none h-10 w-10 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-full"></div>
		case SkeletonImage:
			<div class="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none h-48 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-lg w-full"></div>
		case SkeletonCard:
			<div class="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none space-y-4">
				<div class="h-48 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-lg"></div>
				<div class="space-y-3">
					<div class="h-4 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded w-3/4"></div>
					<div class="h-3 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded w-1/2"></div>
				</div>
			</div>
		case SkeletonTableRow:
			<div class="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-3">
				for range 4 {
					<div class="h-3 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded"></div>
				}
			</div>
		default:
			<div class="animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none h-4 bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded w-full"></div>
	}
}

// skeletonContainer renders the shared aria shell for skeleton groups:
// a single `role="status"` + `aria-busy="true"` wrapper with pulse animation.
// Both SkeletonGroup and SkeletonCardGrid compose through it to avoid
// duplicating the accessibility annotations.
templ skeletonContainer(layoutClass string, label string) {
	<div class={ layoutClass, "animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none" } aria-busy="true" role="status" aria-label={ label }>
		{ children... }
	</div>
}

// SkeletonGroup renders multiple skeleton placeholders under a single
// role="status" announcement to avoid redundant screen-reader reads.
//
//	@feedback.SkeletonGroup([]string{"title", "text", "text", "text"})
templ SkeletonGroup(variants []SkeletonVariant) {
	@skeletonContainer("space-y-3", "Loading content") {
		for _, v := range variants {
			@skeletonBody(v)
		}
	}
}

// SkeletonCardGridProps configures a responsive grid of skeleton cards —
// the common "loading state" for a dashboard card list.
type SkeletonCardGridProps struct {
	// Count is the number of skeleton cards to render. Negative or zero
	// renders a single placeholder so consumers never see an empty container.
	Count int
	// ContainerAware, when true, wraps the grid in a @container div and uses
	// container-query variants (@sm:, @lg:) so the skeleton grid matches the
	// behavior of display.Grid with ContainerAware: true. Useful when
	// the skeleton grid is placed inside a sidebar, card, or other constrained
	// layout. Default false (viewport breakpoints). See ADR-0018.
	ContainerAware bool
}

// DefaultSkeletonCardGridProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultSkeletonCardGridProps() SkeletonCardGridProps {
	return SkeletonCardGridProps{}
}

// skeletonCardGridClassViewport is the viewport-keyed grid class for the
// skeleton card grid (matches GridCols3 in gridColsLookup).
const skeletonCardGridClassViewport = "grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4"

// skeletonCardGridClassContainer mirrors skeletonCardGridClassViewport with
// @container-keyed breakpoints (matches GridCols3 in gridColsContainerLookup).
const skeletonCardGridClassContainer = "grid grid-cols-1 @sm:grid-cols-2 @lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4"

// SkeletonCardGrid renders a responsive grid of N skeleton cards — the common
// "loading state" for a dashboard card list. It wraps SkeletonGroup so the
// whole grid shares one `role="status"` announcement, and uses the same
// responsive grid classes as display.Grid. Negative or zero counts render a
// single placeholder card so consumers never see an empty container.
//
//	@feedback.SkeletonCardGrid(feedback.SkeletonCardGridProps{Count: 6})
//	@feedback.SkeletonCardGrid(feedback.SkeletonCardGridProps{Count: 12, ContainerAware: true})
templ SkeletonCardGrid(props SkeletonCardGridProps) {
	{{
		n := props.Count
		if n <= 0 {
			n = 1
		}
		gridClass := skeletonCardGridClassViewport
		if props.ContainerAware {
			gridClass = skeletonCardGridClassContainer
		}
	}}
	if props.ContainerAware {
		<div class="@container">
			@skeletonContainer(gridClass, "Loading cards") {
				for range n {
					@skeletonBody(SkeletonCard)
				}
			}
		</div>
	} else {
		@skeletonContainer(gridClass, "Loading cards") {
			for range n {
				@skeletonBody(SkeletonCard)
			}
		}
	}
}

# ── feedback/progressbar.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package feedback

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// ProgressBarSize defines the height of a progress bar
type ProgressBarSize string

const (
	ProgressBarSizeSM ProgressBarSize = "sm"
	ProgressBarSizeMD ProgressBarSize = "md"
	ProgressBarSizeLG ProgressBarSize = "lg"
)

// ProgressBarProps configures a progress bar
type ProgressBarProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Current       int
	Total         int
	Label         string
	Size          ProgressBarSize
	Color         string
	ShowLabel     bool
	Indeterminate bool
}

// DefaultProgressBarProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultProgressBarProps() ProgressBarProps {
	return ProgressBarProps{
		Size:  ProgressBarSizeMD,
		Color: "bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500",
	}
}

// ProgressBar renders a progress indicator
//
//	@feedback.ProgressBar(feedback.ProgressBarProps{Current: 45, Total: 100, Label: "Uploading"})
templ ProgressBar(props ProgressBarProps) {
	{{
		percent := 0.0
		if props.Total > 0 {
			percent = float64(props.Current) * 100.0 / float64(props.Total)
		}
		percent = max(0, min(100, percent))
		clamped := max(0, props.Current)
		if props.Total > 0 && clamped > props.Total {
			clamped = props.Total
		}
		// role="progressbar" requires an accessible name (axe aria-progressbar-name).
		// Fall back to the visible label, then a generic name, so the bare
		// progress bar never renders unnamed.
		progressName := props.AriaLabel
		if progressName == "" {
			progressName = props.Label
		}
		if progressName == "" {
			progressName = progressbarFallbackName
		}
	}}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("w-full", props.Class) }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		if props.ShowLabel || props.Label != "" {
			<div class="flex justify-between text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-1">
				<span>{ props.Label }</span>
				if !props.Indeterminate {
					<span>{ fmt.Sprintf("%.0f%%", percent) }</span>
				}
			</div>
		}
		<div class={ progressTrackClass(props.Size) }>
			if props.Indeterminate {
				<div
					class={ "rounded-full animate-indeterminate-progress motion-reduce:animate-none", progressHeightClass(props.Size), props.Color }
					role="progressbar"
					aria-busy="true"
					aria-label={ progressName }
				></div>
			} else {
				<div
					class={ "rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none", progressHeightClass(props.Size), props.Color }
					style={ fmt.Sprintf("width: %.0f%%;", percent) }
					role="progressbar"
					aria-label={ progressName }
					aria-valuenow={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", clamped) }
					aria-valuemin="0"
					aria-valuemax={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.Total) }
				></div>
			}
		</div>
	</div>
}

// progressbarFallbackName is the accessible name for progress bars rendered
// without an explicit AriaLabel or visible Label — role="progressbar" must
// never render unnamed (axe aria-progressbar-name).
const progressbarFallbackName = "Progress"

func progressTrackClass(size ProgressBarSize) string {
	return "w-full bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-full " + progressHeightClass(size)
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for progress bar heights
var progressHeightLookup = map[ProgressBarSize]string{
	ProgressBarSizeSM: "h-1.5",
	ProgressBarSizeMD: "h-2.5",
	ProgressBarSizeLG: "h-4",
}

func progressHeightClass(size ProgressBarSize) string {
	return utils.Lookup(progressHeightLookup, size, "h-2.5")
}

# ── feedback/step_indicator.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package feedback

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// StepIndicatorOrientation defines the layout direction of a step indicator
type StepIndicatorOrientation string

const (
	StepHorizontal StepIndicatorOrientation = "horizontal"
	StepVertical   StepIndicatorOrientation = "vertical"
)

// StepIndicatorProps configures a step/progress indicator
type StepIndicatorProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Steps       []string
	CurrentStep int
	Orientation StepIndicatorOrientation
}

// DefaultStepIndicatorProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultStepIndicatorProps() StepIndicatorProps {
	return StepIndicatorProps{}
}

// StepIndicator renders a step indicator (horizontal or vertical)
//
//	@feedback.StepIndicator(feedback.StepIndicatorProps{Steps: []string{"Details", "Review", "Confirm"}, CurrentStep: 1})
templ StepIndicator(props StepIndicatorProps) {
	<nav
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		aria-label={ utils.Ternary(props.AriaLabel != "", props.AriaLabel, "Progress") }
		class={ utils.Class("", props.Class) }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		if props.Orientation == StepVertical {
			<ol class="flex flex-col space-y-4">
				for i, step := range props.Steps {
					<li class="flex items-start">
						<div class="flex flex-col items-center">
							@stepCircle(i, props.CurrentStep)
							if i < len(props.Steps)-1 {
								<div class={ "w-0.5 h-8", stepLineClass(i+1, props.CurrentStep) }></div>
							}
						</div>
						<span class={ "ms-3 text-sm font-medium mt-1", stepLabelClass(i, props.CurrentStep) }>{ step }</span>
					</li>
				}
			</ol>
		} else {
			<ol class="flex items-center w-full">
				for i, step := range props.Steps {
					<li class={ "flex-1 flex items-center", templ.KV("", i == len(props.Steps)-1) }>
						if i > 0 {
							<div class={ "flex-1 h-0.5 mx-2", stepLineClass(i, props.CurrentStep) }></div>
						}
						<div class="flex flex-col items-center">
							@stepCircle(i, props.CurrentStep)
							<span class={ "mt-2 text-xs font-medium", stepLabelClass(i, props.CurrentStep) }>{ step }</span>
						</div>
					</li>
				}
			</ol>
		}
	</nav>
}

// stepCircle renders the numbered circle (or check icon when complete) shared by
// both the vertical and horizontal step layouts.
templ stepCircle(stepIndex, currentStep int) {
	<div
		class={ "w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-semibold " + utils.TransitionColors, stepCircleClass(stepIndex, currentStep) }
		if stepIndex == currentStep {
			aria-current="step"
		}
	>
		if stepIndex < currentStep {
			@icons.Icon(icons.Check, "w-4 h-4")
		} else {
			{ fmt.Sprintf("%d", stepIndex+1) }
		}
	</div>
}

func stepLineClass(stepIndex, currentStep int) string {
	if stepIndex <= currentStep {
		return "bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500"
	}
	return "bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700"
}

func stepCircleClass(stepIndex, currentStep int) string {
	if stepIndex < currentStep {
		return "bg-blue-600 text-white dark:bg-blue-500"
	}
	if stepIndex == currentStep {
		return "bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border-2 border-blue-600 text-blue-600 dark:border-blue-400 dark:text-blue-400"
	}
	return "bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-400"
}

func stepLabelClass(stepIndex, currentStep int) string {
	if stepIndex <= currentStep {
		return "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
	}
	return "text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
}

# ── feedback/styles.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Feedback style lookups: shared style sets, icon mapping, and generic enum lookup.
package feedback

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// FeedbackType represents the severity/visual style of a feedback component.
// Shared by Alert and Toast components.
type FeedbackType string

// Feedback severity levels shared by Alert and Toast components.
const (
	FeedbackSuccess FeedbackType = "success"
	FeedbackError   FeedbackType = "error"
	FeedbackWarning FeedbackType = "warning"
	FeedbackInfo    FeedbackType = "info"
)

// feedbackStyleSet holds the CSS classes for a feedback component variant.
type feedbackStyleSet struct {
	Border, BG, Text, Icon string
}

// feedbackStyleMap is the single source of truth for feedback styles.
// Shared by Alert and Toast to guarantee visual consistency for the same severity.
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table; Tailwind class strings are intentionally inline
var feedbackStyleMap = map[FeedbackType]feedbackStyleSet{
	FeedbackSuccess: {
		Border: "border-green-200 dark:border-green-800",
		BG:     "bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20",
		Text:   "text-green-800 dark:text-green-200",
		Icon:   "text-green-600 dark:text-green-400",
	},
	FeedbackError: {
		Border: "border-red-200 dark:border-red-800",
		BG:     "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20",
		Text:   "text-red-800 dark:text-red-200",
		Icon:   "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
	},
	FeedbackWarning: {
		Border: "border-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800",
		BG:     "bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-yellow-900/20",
		Text:   "text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-200",
		Icon:   "text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400",
	},
	FeedbackInfo: {
		Border: "border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800",
		BG:     "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20",
		Text:   "text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200",
		Icon:   "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400",
	},
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level default fallback
var feedbackStyleDefault = feedbackStyleSet{
	Border: "border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700",
	BG:     "bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50",
	Text:   "text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200",
	Icon:   "text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400",
}

// feedbackIconMap is the single source of truth for feedback icons.
// Uses circle-style icons for clear completion/failure semantics.
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for shared feedback icons
var feedbackIconMap = map[FeedbackType]icons.Name{
	FeedbackSuccess: icons.CheckCircle,
	FeedbackError:   icons.XCircle,
	FeedbackWarning: icons.ExclamationTriangle,
	FeedbackInfo:    icons.Information,
}

func feedbackStyle(t FeedbackType) feedbackStyleSet {
	return utils.Lookup(feedbackStyleMap, t, feedbackStyleDefault)
}

// feedbackRole maps the feedback type onto the ARIA role: errors announce
// assertively (role="alert"); every other severity reports politely
// (role="status") so success and info banners are not read as errors by
// screen readers. Mirrors the inlineMessage twins' split (InlineError
// "alert" vs InlineSuccess "status").
func feedbackRole(t FeedbackType) string {
	if t == FeedbackError {
		return "alert"
	}

	return "status"
}

func feedbackIcon(t FeedbackType) icons.Name {
	return utils.Lookup(feedbackIconMap, t, icons.Information)
}

// FeedbackTypeIsValid reports whether the FeedbackType value is one of the
// four defined constants (Success, Error, Warning, Info).
func FeedbackTypeIsValid(t FeedbackType) bool {
	_, ok := feedbackStyleMap[t]

	return ok
}

# ── feedback/toast.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package feedback

import (
	"fmt"
	"html"
	"strings"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// ToastProps configures a toast notification
type ToastProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Message  string
	Title    string
	Type     FeedbackType
	Duration int // milliseconds, 0 for no auto-dismiss
}

// Default toast durations
const (
	ToastDurationShort  = 3000
	ToastDurationMedium = 5000
	ToastDurationLong   = 8000
)

// toastJSStyles generates the JS color map string from the Go style definitions
func toastJSStyles() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("var tcToastColors = {")
	for _, t := range []FeedbackType{FeedbackSuccess, FeedbackError, FeedbackWarning, FeedbackInfo} {
		s := feedbackStyleMap[t]
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "'%s': {border:'%s',bg:'%s',text:'%s',icon:'%s'},", t, s.Border, s.BG, s.Text, s.Icon)
	}
	b.WriteString("};")
	return b.String()
}

func toastJSIconPaths() string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("var tcToastIcons = {")
	for _, t := range []FeedbackType{FeedbackSuccess, FeedbackError, FeedbackWarning, FeedbackInfo} {
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "'%s':'%s',", t, icons.IconPathJS(feedbackIconMap[t]))
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "dismiss:'%s'", icons.IconPathJS(icons.X))
	b.WriteString("};")
	return b.String()
}

// toastScriptNonceAttr renders the nonce attribute for the raw <script>
// tags below. An empty nonce omits the attribute entirely (nonce="" is
// rejected by strict-CSP pages — the omit-empty rule, see utils.ScriptAttrs).
func toastScriptNonceAttr(nonce string) string {
	if nonce == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf(` nonce="%s"`, html.EscapeString(nonce))
}

// toastContainerScript builds the entire <script> tag as raw HTML.
// This bypasses templ's ScriptContentOutsideStringLiteral which would
// JSON-marshal the JS string content inside {{ }} expressions.
func toastContainerScript(nonce string) templ.Component {
	script := fmt.Sprintf(`<script%s>%s\n%s\nfunction tcShowToast(message, type, title, duration) {\nvar container = document.getElementById('tc-toast-container');\nif (!container) return;\nvar toast = document.createElement('div');\nvar typeKey = type || 'info';\nvar style = tcToastColors[typeKey] || tcToastColors.info;\ntoast.className = 'pointer-events-auto max-w-sm w-full rounded-lg border shadow-lg dark:shadow-black/20 px-4 py-3 transform transition-all duration-300 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0 translate-x-full ' + style.border + ' ' + style.bg + ' ' + style.text;\nvar inner = document.createElement('div');\ninner.className = 'flex items-start gap-3';\nvar svgEl = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');\nsvgEl.setAttribute('class', 'h-5 w-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5 ' + style.icon);\nsvgEl.setAttribute('fill', 'none');\nsvgEl.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');\nsvgEl.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');\nsvgEl.innerHTML = (tcToastIcons[typeKey] || tcToastIcons.info);\ninner.appendChild(svgEl);\nvar content = document.createElement('div');\ncontent.className = 'flex-1 min-w-0';\nif (title) {\nvar titleEl = document.createElement('div');\ntitleEl.className = 'text-sm font-semibold';\ntitleEl.textContent = title;\ncontent.appendChild(titleEl);\n}\nvar msgEl = document.createElement('div');\nmsgEl.className = 'text-sm';\nmsgEl.textContent = message;\ncontent.appendChild(msgEl);\ninner.appendChild(content);\nvar btn = document.createElement('button');\nbtn.className = 'flex-shrink-0 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-200 transition-colors motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0';\nbtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Dismiss');\nbtn.addEventListener('click', function() { this.closest('.pointer-events-auto').remove(); });\nbtn.innerHTML = '<svg class="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">' + (tcToastIcons.dismiss || '') + '</svg>';\ninner.appendChild(btn);\ntoast.appendChild(inner);\ncontainer.appendChild(toast);\nrequestAnimationFrame(function() { toast.classList.remove('translate-x-full'); });\nif (duration && duration > 0) {\nsetTimeout(function() {\ntoast.classList.add('translate-x-full');\nsetTimeout(function() { toast.remove(); }, 300);\n}, duration);\n}\n}</script>`, toastScriptNonceAttr(nonce), toastJSStyles(), toastJSIconPaths())
	script = strings.ReplaceAll(script, `\n`, "\n")
	return templ.Raw(script)
}

// toastDismissScript builds the dismiss <script> tag as raw HTML.
func toastDismissScript(nonce, toastID string, duration int) templ.Component {
	js := utils.DismissScript()
	if duration > 0 {
		js += fmt.Sprintf("setTimeout(function(){var t=document.getElementById('%s');if(t)t.remove();},%d);", toastID, duration)
	}
	return templ.Raw(fmt.Sprintf(`<script%s>%s</script>`, toastScriptNonceAttr(nonce), js))
}

// DefaultToastProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultToastProps() ToastProps {
	return ToastProps{
		Type:     FeedbackInfo,
		Duration: ToastDurationMedium,
	}
}

// ToastContainer renders the fixed-position container for toasts
// Place this once near the top of your body
//
//	@feedback.ToastContainer()
templ ToastContainer(nonce string) {
	<div id="tc-toast-container" class="fixed bottom-4 inset-e-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 pointer-events-none" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
		<!-- Toasts are injected here -->
	</div>
	@toastContainerScript(nonce)
}

// Toast renders a single toast notification (server-side rendered)
// For HTMX responses, use ToastContainer + the tcShowToast() JS function
//
//	@feedback.Toast(feedback.ToastProps{Message: "Saved!", Type: feedback.FeedbackSuccess})
templ Toast(props ToastProps) {
	{{ toastID := utils.EnsureID("toast", props.ID) }}
	{{ s := feedbackStyle(props.Type) }}
	<div
		id={ toastID }
		class={ utils.Class("max-w-sm w-full rounded-lg border shadow-lg dark:shadow-black/20 px-4 py-3 transform transition-all duration-300 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0", s.Border, s.BG, props.Class) }
		role="status"
		aria-live="polite"
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<div class="flex items-start gap-3">
			@icons.Icon(feedbackIcon(props.Type), utils.Class("h-5 w-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5", s.Icon))
			<div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
				if props.Title != "" {
					<div class={ "text-sm font-semibold", s.Text }>{ props.Title }</div>
				}
				<div class={ "text-sm", s.Text }>{ props.Message }</div>
			</div>
			<button
				data-dismiss="toast"
				class={ "flex-shrink-0 p-1.5 -m-1.5 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:text-gray-200 " + utils.TransitionColors }
				aria-label="Dismiss"
			>
				@icons.Icon(icons.X, "h-4 w-4")
			</button>
		</div>
	</div>
	if props.Duration > 0 {
		@toastDismissScript(props.Nonce, toastID, props.Duration)
	} else {
		@toastDismissScript(props.Nonce, toastID, 0)
	}
}

# ── forms/aria.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// ARIA attribute helpers for form field accessibility.
package forms

import "github.com/a-h/templ"

const (
	ariaDescribedBy = "aria-describedby"
	ariaInvalid     = "aria-invalid"
	ariaTrue        = "true"
	errorIDSuffix   = "-error"
)

// ErrorAttrs returns templ attributes for aria-invalid and aria-describedby
// when an error message or help text is present. Returns nil only when both
// errorMessage and helpTextID are empty. When helpTextID is non-empty it is always
// emitted via aria-describedby (independent of id), so id-less fields with help
// text remain accessible to assistive technology.
func ErrorAttrs(id, errorMessage, helpTextID string) templ.Attributes {
	if errorMessage == "" {
		if helpTextID != "" {
			return templ.Attributes{ariaDescribedBy: helpTextID}
		}

		return nil
	}

	attrs := templ.Attributes{
		ariaInvalid: ariaTrue,
	}

	switch {
	case id != "" && helpTextID != "":
		attrs[ariaDescribedBy] = id + errorIDSuffix + " " + helpTextID
	case id != "":
		attrs[ariaDescribedBy] = id + errorIDSuffix
	case helpTextID != "":
		attrs[ariaDescribedBy] = helpTextID
	}

	return attrs
}

# ── forms/calendar.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/wire"
)

// CalendarProps configures a month-view calendar for date selection.
// Navigation is server-side via HrefPrev/HrefNext links.
type CalendarProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	// Year and Month define which month to display.
	Year  int
	Month time.Month
	// SelectedDate highlights the matching day.
	SelectedDate *time.Time
	// HrefBase is the URL pattern for day links. Use {year}, {month}, {day} as placeholders.
	// Example: "/calendar?year={year}&month={month}&day={day}"
	HrefBase string
	// HrefPrev/HrefNext are URLs for the prev/next month navigation links.
	HrefPrev string
	HrefNext string
	// MonthNav, when set, wires the prev/next month links for partial-page
	// updates in BOTH transport dialects (htmx hx-get or a Datastar
	// @get binding) instead of full-page navigation. The URL carries the
	// SAME {year}/{month} placeholders as HrefBase — the component clones
	// the action per direction and substitutes the target month, so one
	// action serves both arrows. A nil MonthNav keeps the href-only
	// behavior; a set HrefPrev/HrefNext alongside renders as the no-JS
	// fallback href.
	//
	//	MonthNav: &wire.Action{URL: "/api/calendar?year={year}&month={month}", Target: "#calendar"}
	MonthNav *wire.Action
	// MinDate/MaxDate disable days outside the range.
	MinDate *time.Time
	MaxDate *time.Time
}

// DefaultCalendarProps returns sensible defaults (current month).
func DefaultCalendarProps() CalendarProps {
	now := time.Now()
	return CalendarProps{
		Year:  now.Year(),
		Month: now.Month(),
	}
}

// calendarDayClass returns the classes for a single day cell.
func calendarDayClass(selected, disabled, isToday bool) string {
	base := "flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm transition-colors motion-reduce:transition-none"
	if disabled {
		return base + " text-gray-300 dark:text-gray-600 cursor-not-allowed"
	}
	if selected {
		return base + " bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 text-white font-semibold"
	}
	if isToday {
		return base + " ring-1 ring-inset ring-blue-600 dark:ring-blue-500 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-medium hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/30"
	}
	return base + " text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
}

// calendarReplacePlaceholders replaces {year}, {month}, {day} in href.
func calendarReplacePlaceholders(href string, year int, month time.Month, day int) string {
	r := strings.NewReplacer("{year}", fmt.Sprintf("%d", year), "{month}", fmt.Sprintf("%d", int(month)), "{day}", fmt.Sprintf("%d", day))
	return r.Replace(href)
}

// Calendar renders a month-view calendar with server-side navigation.
// Each day is a link (when HrefBase is set) or a span.
//
//	@forms.Calendar(forms.CalendarProps{
//	   Year:  2026, Month: time.July,
//	   SelectedDate: &someDate,
//	   HrefBase: "/calendar?y={year}&m={month}&d={day}",
//	   HrefPrev: "/calendar?y=2026&m=6",
//	   HrefNext: "/calendar?y=2026&m=8",
//	})
templ Calendar(props CalendarProps) {
	{{
		firstOfDay := time.Date(props.Year, props.Month, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
		daysInMonth := firstOfDay.AddDate(0, 1, -1).Day()
		startWeekday := int(firstOfDay.Weekday())
		today := time.Now()
		isToday := func(day int) bool {
			return today.Year() == props.Year && today.Month() == props.Month && today.Day() == day
		}
		isDisabled := func(day int) bool {
			d := time.Date(props.Year, props.Month, day, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
			if props.MinDate != nil && d.Before(*props.MinDate) {
				return true
			}
			if props.MaxDate != nil && d.After(*props.MaxDate) {
				return true
			}
			return false
		}
		isSelected := func(day int) bool {
			if props.SelectedDate == nil {
				return false
			}
			return props.SelectedDate.Year() == props.Year && props.SelectedDate.Month() == props.Month && props.SelectedDate.Day() == day
		}
		monthName := props.Month.String()
		prevYear, prevMonth := calendarPrevMonth(props.Year, props.Month)
		nextYear, nextMonth := calendarNextMonth(props.Year, props.Month)
		prevHref := calendarMonthNavHref(props.HrefPrev, props.MonthNav, prevYear, prevMonth)
		nextHref := calendarMonthNavHref(props.HrefNext, props.MonthNav, nextYear, nextMonth)
	}}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("inline-block rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 p-4", props.Class) }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
			if prevHref != "" {
				@calendarMonthNavLink(prevHref, calendarMonthNavAction(props.MonthNav, prevYear, prevMonth), calendarPrevMonthLabel, icons.ChevronLeft)
			} else {
				<span class="w-7"></span>
			}
			<h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{ monthName } { fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.Year) }</h3>
			if nextHref != "" {
				@calendarMonthNavLink(nextHref, calendarMonthNavAction(props.MonthNav, nextYear, nextMonth), calendarNextMonthLabel, icons.ChevronRight)
			} else {
				<span class="w-7"></span>
			}
		</div>
		<div class="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 mb-1">
			for _, dow := range []string{"Su", "Mo", "Tu", "We", "Th", "Fr", "Sa"} {
				<div class="flex h-8 w-9 items-center justify-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{ dow }</div>
			}
		</div>
		<div class="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1" role="group" aria-label={ monthName }>
			for _ = range startWeekday {
				<div class="h-9 w-9"></div>
			}
			for day := 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++ {
				{{ selected := isSelected(day) }}
				{{ disabled := isDisabled(day) }}
				{{ dayHref := "" }}
				if props.HrefBase != "" && !disabled {
					{{ dayHref = calendarReplacePlaceholders(props.HrefBase, props.Year, props.Month, day) }}
				}
				<div class="flex justify-center">
					if dayHref != "" {
						<a href={ templ.SafeURL(dayHref) } class={ calendarDayClass(selected, false, isToday(day)) }>
							{ fmt.Sprintf("%d", day) }
						</a>
					} else {
						<span class={ calendarDayClass(selected, disabled, isToday(day)) }>
							{ fmt.Sprintf("%d", day) }
						</span>
					}
				</div>
			}
		</div>
	</div>
}

// calendarMonthNavLink renders one month-navigation anchor (previous or
// next). The href is the no-JS fallback; MonthNav wiring, when set, is
// spread as transport attributes by the caller.
templ calendarMonthNavLink(href string, action templ.Attributes, label string, icon icons.Name) {
	<a
		href={ templ.SafeURL(href) }
		{ action... }
		class="p-1 rounded-md text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 dark:hover:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
		aria-label={ label }
	>
		@icons.Icon(icon, "h-5 w-5")
	</a>
}

# ── forms/calendar_nav.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/wire"
)

// calendarMonthNavAction clones the Calendar MonthNav action for one
// direction, substituting {year}/{month} placeholders with the navigation
// target month. It never mutates the consumer's action (copy semantics —
// the kanban lesson: components must not rewrite consumer-supplied specs).
// The clone sets PreventDefault: NavLink-style anchors whose href is the
// no-JS fallback must not ALSO navigate when the Datastar runtime handles
// the click (the runtime auto-preventDefaults only form+submit — decoded
// from the pinned v1.0.3 bundle); htmx intercepts wired clicks itself.
//
// htmx additionally gets hx-swap="outerHTML settle:0s": the endpoint
// re-renders the WHOLE calendar, and outer-HTML self-replacement is the
// library's proven re-binding pattern (kanban, LoadMore). settle:0s makes
// htmx process the swapped-in anchors in the same JS task as the swap —
// with the default 20ms settle delay the new arrows stay inert for that
// window, and month arrows are exactly the kind of control users click in
// quick bursts (e2e-verified 2026-09-13: a click inside the window silently
// no-ops). Point Target at the calendar's own id.
func calendarMonthNavAction(base *wire.Action, year int, month time.Month) templ.Attributes {
	if base == nil || base.URL == "" {
		return nil
	}

	nav := *base
	nav.URL = calendarMonthNavURL(base, year, month)
	nav.PreventDefault = true

	attrs := nav.Attributes()
	if attrs != nil && nav.Transport != wire.TransportDatastar {
		attrs["hx-swap"] = calendarMonthNavSwap
	}

	return attrs
}

// calendarMonthNavURL substitutes {year}/{month} placeholders in the action
// URL with the navigation target month. Empty when the action is nil or
// carries no URL (an unwired action must stay inert).
func calendarMonthNavURL(base *wire.Action, year int, month time.Month) string {
	if base == nil || base.URL == "" {
		return ""
	}

	url := strings.ReplaceAll(base.URL, "{year}", strconv.Itoa(year))

	return strings.ReplaceAll(url, "{month}", strconv.Itoa(int(month)))
}

// calendarMonthNavHref resolves the arrow's href: the explicit
// HrefPrev/HrefNext when set, otherwise the substituted MonthNav URL —
// progressive enhancement, so without JS the arrow navigates to the same
// endpoint the runtime patches. Never returns a roleless aria-labelled
// anchor: an <a> without href carries no implicit role, and aria-label on
// it is an axe aria-prohibited-attr serious violation (found by the demo
// axe sweep 2026-09-14). Callers render the arrow only when this returns
// a non-empty href.
func calendarMonthNavHref(explicit string, base *wire.Action, year int, month time.Month) string {
	if explicit != "" {
		return explicit
	}

	return calendarMonthNavURL(base, year, month)
}

// calendarMonthNavSwap self-replaces the calendar and settles synchronously.
const calendarMonthNavSwap = "outerHTML settle:0s"

// Accessible names for the month-navigation arrows (named constants per the
// goconst discipline — the literals appear in calendar.templ and its tests).
const (
	calendarPrevMonthLabel = "Previous month"
	calendarNextMonthLabel = "Next month"
)

// calendarPrevMonth returns the year/month before the given one
// (December wraps to the previous year).
func calendarPrevMonth(year int, month time.Month) (int, time.Month) {
	if month == time.January {
		return year - 1, time.December
	}

	return year, month - 1
}

// calendarNextMonth returns the year/month after the given one
// (January wraps to the next year).
func calendarNextMonth(year int, month time.Month) (int, time.Month) {
	if month == time.December {
		return year + 1, time.January
	}

	return year, month + 1
}

# ── forms/combobox.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// ComboboxOption represents a single selectable option in a combobox.
type ComboboxOption struct {
	Value string
	Label string
}

// ComboboxProps configures an autocomplete text input with a filterable
// dropdown of options. The selected value is submitted via a hidden input
// with the given Name, so it works in plain HTML forms and HTMX requests.
type ComboboxProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name        string
	Label       string
	Placeholder string
	Options     []ComboboxOption
	Value       string
	Required    bool
	Disabled    bool
	Error       string
	HelpText    string
}

// DefaultComboboxProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultComboboxProps() ComboboxProps {
	return ComboboxProps{}
}

// comboboxInputClass returns the base class for the combobox text input,
// adding an error ring when the field is in an invalid state.
func comboboxInputClass(hasError bool) string {
	base := "block w-full rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 px-3 py-2 text-base text-gray-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:placeholder:text-gray-500 border-0 ring-1 ring-inset caret-blue-600 dark:caret-blue-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset sm:text-sm transition-shadow motion-reduce:transition-none"
	if hasError {
		return base + " ring-red-300 focus:ring-red-500 dark:ring-red-700 dark:focus:ring-red-500"
	}
	return base + " ring-gray-300 dark:ring-gray-600 focus:ring-blue-600 dark:focus:ring-blue-500"
}

// comboboxDisplayLabel resolves the human-readable label to show in the text
// input. props.Value holds the submission value (the option Value); the
// matching option's Label is shown for display so the submitted value stays
// the machine value, not the human text.
func comboboxDisplayLabel(props ComboboxProps) string {
	for _, opt := range props.Options {
		if opt.Value == props.Value {
			return opt.Label
		}
	}
	return props.Value
}

// Combobox renders an accessible autocomplete input with a filterable dropdown.
// As the user types, options are filtered client-side. Clicking an option fills
// the input and sets the hidden value for form submission.
//
//	@forms.Combobox(forms.ComboboxProps{
//	   Name: "country",
//	   ID: "country",
//	   Label: "Country",
//	   Placeholder: "Search countries...",
//	   Options: []forms.ComboboxOption{
//	     {Value: "de", Label: "Germany"},
//	     {Value: "at", Label: "Austria"},
//	   },
//	})
templ Combobox(props ComboboxProps) {
	{{ id := utils.EnsureID("combobox", props.ID) }}
	{{ displayValue := comboboxDisplayLabel(props) }}
	@FormFieldWrapper(FormFieldProps{ID: id, Label: props.Label, Required: props.Required, Error: props.Error, HelpText: props.HelpText}) {
		<div class="relative" data-combobox={ id }>
			<input
				type="text"
				id={ id }
				if props.Placeholder != "" {
					placeholder={ props.Placeholder }
				}
				value={ displayValue }
				class={ utils.Class(comboboxInputClass(props.Error != ""), props.Class) }
				role="combobox"
				aria-expanded="false"
				aria-controls={ id + "-listbox" }
				aria-autocomplete="list"
				autocomplete="off"
				data-combobox-input={ id }
				if props.Required {
					required
					aria-required="true"
				}
				if props.Disabled {
					disabled
				}
				if props.AriaLabel != "" {
					aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
				}
				{ ErrorAttrs(id, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(id), ""))... }
				{ props.Attrs... }
			/>
			<input
				type="hidden"
				name={ props.Name }
				value={ props.Value }
				data-combobox-value={ id }
				if props.Disabled {
					disabled
				}
			/>
			<ul
				id={ id + "-listbox" }
				role="listbox"
				class="hidden absolute z-10 mt-1 max-h-60 w-full overflow-auto rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 py-1 text-base shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5 focus:outline-hidden sm:text-sm"
				data-combobox-list={ id }
			>
				for _, opt := range props.Options {
					<li
						role="option"
						id={ id + "-option-" + opt.Value }
						tabindex="-1"
						aria-selected="false"
						class="relative cursor-pointer select-none py-2 ps-3 pe-9 text-gray-900 dark:text-white hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 data-[selected]:bg-blue-50 dark:data-[selected]:bg-gray-700"
						data-combobox-option={ opt.Value }
						data-combobox-label={ opt.Label }
					>
						{ opt.Label }
					</li>
				}
			</ul>
		</div>
	}
	<script { utils.ScriptAttrs(props.Nonce)... }>
		if (!window.tcComboboxAttached) {
			window.tcComboboxAttached = true;
			function tcClearComboSelection(opts, input) {
				opts.forEach(function(o) {
					o.removeAttribute('data-selected');
					o.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
				});
				input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
			}
			document.addEventListener('input', function(e) {
				var input = e.target.closest('[data-combobox-input]');
				if (!input) return;
				var id = input.getAttribute('data-combobox-input');
				var list = document.querySelector('[data-combobox-list="' + id + '"]');
				if (!list) return;
				var hidden = document.querySelector('[data-combobox-value="' + id + '"]');
				if (hidden) hidden.value = '';
				var query = input.value.toLowerCase();
				var visible = 0;
				list.querySelectorAll('[data-combobox-option]').forEach(function(opt) {
					var label = opt.getAttribute('data-combobox-label').toLowerCase();
					var match = label.includes(query);
					opt.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
					if (match) visible++;
				});
				if (visible > 0) {
					list.classList.remove('hidden');
					input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
				} else {
					list.classList.add('hidden');
					input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
				}
			});
			document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				var opt = e.target.closest('[data-combobox-option]');
				if (opt) {
					var list = opt.closest('[data-combobox-list]');
					if (!list) return;
					var id = list.getAttribute('data-combobox-list');
					var input = document.querySelector('[data-combobox-input="' + id + '"]');
					var hidden = document.querySelector('[data-combobox-value="' + id + '"]');
					var label = opt.getAttribute('data-combobox-label');
					var value = opt.getAttribute('data-combobox-option');
					if (input) {
						input.value = label;
						input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
					}
					if (hidden) hidden.value = value;
					if (list) list.classList.add('hidden');
				}
			});
			document.addEventListener('focusin', function(e) {
				var input = e.target.closest('[data-combobox-input]');
				if (!input) return;
				var id = input.getAttribute('data-combobox-input');
				var list = document.querySelector('[data-combobox-list="' + id + '"]');
				if (list && list.querySelector('[data-combobox-option]')) {
					list.classList.remove('hidden');
					input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
				}
			});
			document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				var input = e.target.closest('[data-combobox-input]');
				var list = e.target.closest('[data-combobox-list]');
				if (!input && !list) {
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-combobox-list]').forEach(function(l) {
						l.classList.add('hidden');
					});
					document.querySelectorAll('[data-combobox-input]').forEach(function(i) {
						i.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
					});
				}
			});
			document.addEventListener('focusout', function(e) {
				var input = e.target.closest('[data-combobox-input]');
				if (!input) return;
				var container = input.closest('[data-combobox]');
				if (container && container.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
				var id = input.getAttribute('data-combobox-input');
				var list = document.querySelector('[data-combobox-list="' + id + '"]');
				if (list) {
					list.classList.add('hidden');
					var opts = Array.prototype.slice.call(list.querySelectorAll('[data-combobox-option]'));
					tcClearComboSelection(opts, input);
				}
				input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			});
			document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
				var input = e.target.closest('[data-combobox-input]');
				if (!input) return;
				var id = input.getAttribute('data-combobox-input');
				var list = document.querySelector('[data-combobox-list="' + id + '"]');
				if (!list) return;
				var opts = Array.prototype.slice.call(list.querySelectorAll('[data-combobox-option]')).filter(function(o) {
					return o.style.display !== 'none';
				});
				if (e.key === 'Tab') {
					list.classList.add('hidden');
					input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
					tcClearComboSelection(opts, input);
					return;
				}
				if (e.key === 'Escape') {
					list.classList.add('hidden');
					input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
					tcClearComboSelection(opts, input);
					return;
				}
				if (opts.length === 0) return;
				if (e.key === 'Enter') {
					var enterIdx = -1;
					opts.forEach(function(o, i) { if (o.getAttribute('data-selected') === 'true') enterIdx = i; });
					if (enterIdx >= 0) {
						e.preventDefault();
						var sel = opts[enterIdx];
						input.value = sel.getAttribute('data-combobox-label');
						var hidden = document.querySelector('[data-combobox-value="' + id + '"]');
						if (hidden) hidden.value = sel.getAttribute('data-combobox-option');
						list.classList.add('hidden');
						input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
						tcClearComboSelection(opts, input);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'Home' || e.key === 'End') {
					e.preventDefault();
					list.classList.remove('hidden');
					input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
				}
				var currentIdx = -1;
				opts.forEach(function(o, i) {
					if (o.getAttribute('data-selected') === 'true') currentIdx = i;
				});
				var nextIdx = currentIdx;
				switch (e.key) {
					case 'ArrowDown': nextIdx = currentIdx < opts.length - 1 ? currentIdx + 1 : 0; break;
					case 'ArrowUp':   nextIdx = currentIdx > 0 ? currentIdx - 1 : opts.length - 1; break;
					case 'Home':      nextIdx = 0; break;
					case 'End':       nextIdx = opts.length - 1; break;
				}
				if (nextIdx !== currentIdx) {
					tcClearComboSelection(opts, input);
					var sel = opts[nextIdx];
					sel.setAttribute('data-selected', 'true');
					sel.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
					input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', sel.getAttribute('id') || '');
					sel.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
				}
			});
		}
	</script>
}

# ── forms/date_picker.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// DatePickerProps configures a native HTML date input
type DatePickerProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name     string
	Value    string
	Label    string
	Min      string
	Max      string
	Required bool
	Disabled bool
	Error    string
	HelpText string
}

// DefaultDatePickerProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultDatePickerProps() DatePickerProps {
	return DatePickerProps{}
}

// DatePicker renders a labeled date input with optional min/max constraints,
// error, and help text
//
//	@forms.DatePicker(forms.DatePickerProps{
//	   Name: "birthday",
//	   ID: "birthday",
//	   Label: "Date of Birth",
//	   Required: true,
//	})
templ DatePicker(props DatePickerProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	@FormFieldWrapper(FormFieldProps{ID: props.ID, Label: props.Label, Required: props.Required, Error: props.Error, HelpText: props.HelpText}) {
		<input
			type="date"
			name={ props.Name }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			value={ props.Value }
			if props.Min != "" {
				min={ props.Min }
			}
			if props.Max != "" {
				max={ props.Max }
			}
			class={ utils.Class(baseInputClass(props.Error != ""), props.Class) }
			if props.Required {
				required
				aria-required="true"
			}
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		/>
	}
}

# ── forms/dirty_guard.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// DirtyGuardProps configures the unsaved-changes guard script.
type DirtyGuardProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
}

// dirtyGuardJS is the unsaved-changes guard: event delegation on document
// (capture phase, so control-level events are caught without per-form
// listeners), a WeakSet of dirty forms, and a beforeunload check.
const dirtyGuardJS = `
if (!window.tcDirtyGuardAttached) {
  window.tcDirtyGuardAttached = true;
  var tcDirtyForms = new WeakSet();
  var tcDirtyMark = function (e) {
    var f = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-tc-dirty-guard]') : null;
    if (f) tcDirtyForms.add(f);
  };
  document.addEventListener('input', tcDirtyMark, true);
  document.addEventListener('change', tcDirtyMark, true);
  document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    if (e.target && e.target.matches && e.target.matches('[data-tc-dirty-guard]')) tcDirtyForms.delete(e.target);
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function (e) {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll('[data-tc-dirty-guard]');
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i++) {
      if (tcDirtyForms.has(forms[i])) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = '';
        return;
      }
    }
  });
}
`

// dirtyGuardScriptComponent writes the guard script raw: templ's <script>
// context sanitizes interpolations, and the JS must land verbatim. The
// script always renders so non-CSP consumers still get the guard;
// utils.ScriptComponent owns the omit-empty nonce rule and the CSP-safe
// write (nonce="" is rejected by strict-CSP pages — see utils.ScriptAttrs).
func dirtyGuardScriptComponent(nonce string) templ.Component {
	return utils.ScriptComponent(nonce, dirtyGuardJS, "dirty guard script")
}

// DirtyGuard renders the page-level script for the unsaved-changes guard.
// Include it once per page; forms opt in by rendering the
// `data-tc-dirty-guard` attribute (forms.FormProps.DirtyGuard does this).
// The guard marks a guarded form dirty on any input or change and clears it
// when that form submits (native and wired submits both dispatch the submit
// event, so HTMX and Datastar submissions clear the flag too). When the
// user tries to leave with a dirty form, the browser's native confirmation
// dialog appears — the dialog text is chosen by the browser, not the page.
//
// The script is idempotent across HTMX swaps and Datastar patches (global
// singleton flag, ADR-0005) and tracks form elements in a WeakSet, so
// swapped-in forms start clean without any re-initialization. Auto-submit
// filter components (FilterInput) do not dispatch submit events — apply the
// guard to save-style forms, not live filters.
//
//	@forms.DirtyGuard(forms.DirtyGuardProps{Nonce: nonce})
//	...
//	@forms.Form(forms.FormProps{Action: "/save", DirtyGuard: true}) { ... }
templ DirtyGuard(props DirtyGuardProps) {
	@dirtyGuardScriptComponent(props.Nonce)
}

// ToggleSizeIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined ToggleSize constants.
func ToggleSizeIsValid(v ToggleSize) bool {
	_, ok := toggleSizeMap[v]

	return ok
}

// InputTypeIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined InputType constants.
func InputTypeIsValid(v InputType) bool {
	return validInputTypes[v]
}

// FormMethodIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined FormMethod constants.

	return validFormMethods[v]
}

# ── forms/file_input.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// FileInputProps configures a file input
type FileInputProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name     string
	Label    string
	Required bool
	Disabled bool
	Error    string
	HelpText string
	Accept   string // e.g. ".jpg,.png" or "image/*"
	Multiple bool
}

// DefaultFileInputProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultFileInputProps() FileInputProps {
	return FileInputProps{}
}

// fileInputClass returns the shared Tailwind classes for file inputs,
// using the file: modifier to style the native button.
func fileInputClass(hasError bool) string {
	base := "block w-full text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-300 file:me-4 file:rounded-md file:border-0 file:px-4 file:py-2 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-blue-600 file:text-white hover:file:bg-blue-500 dark:file:bg-blue-500 dark:hover:file:bg-blue-400 " + utils.TransitionColors + " cursor-pointer"
	if hasError {
		return base + " ring-1 ring-inset ring-red-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset focus:ring-red-500 rounded-md dark:ring-red-700 dark:focus:ring-red-500"
	}
	return base + " ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset focus:ring-blue-600 rounded-md dark:ring-gray-700 dark:focus:ring-blue-500"
}

// FileInput renders a labeled file input with styled native button
//
//	@forms.FileInput(forms.FileInputProps{
//	   Name: "avatar",
//	   Label: "Upload avatar",
//	   Accept: "image/*",
//	})
templ FileInput(props FileInputProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	@FormFieldWrapper(FormFieldProps{ID: props.ID, Label: props.Label, Required: props.Required, Error: props.Error, HelpText: props.HelpText}) {
		<input
			type="file"
			name={ props.Name }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class(fileInputClass(props.Error != ""), props.Class) }
			if props.Required {
				required
				aria-required="true"
			}
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if props.Accept != "" {
				accept={ props.Accept }
			}
			if props.Multiple {
				multiple
			}
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
			{ props.Attrs... }
		/>
	}
}

# ── forms/filter_bar.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// FilterBar component: the horizontal auto-submit filter row for list
// pages — the converged shape behind DiscordSync's filterForm (9 list pages)
// and dnsblockd's filter rows, extracted per the 2026-10-10 four-project
// analysis (TODO_LIST #390). Composes FilterDropdown/FilterInput/Checkbox
// children; see docs/recipes/horizontal-filter-bar.md for the pattern this
// component productizes (including the two battle-tested footguns it encodes).
package forms

import (
	"github.com/a-h/templ"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/wire"
)

// FilterBarProps configures a horizontal auto-submit filter bar. The bar is
// a GET form: children render the filter controls (FilterDropdown selects,
// checkboxes, search inputs, hidden inputs); any select or checkbox change
// re-submits the form without a page reload, and the noscript Apply button
// keeps non-JS browsers working with a full-page load.
type FilterBarProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	// Action is the list-page URL: the form's GET action (the no-JS
	// fallback), the Reset link target, and — when Wire is unset — the
	// auto-submit fetch URL. An empty Action renders an unwired form
	// (inert bar; useful for pure-CSS composition).
	Action string
	// Wire, when set with a non-empty URL, owns the auto-submit wiring in
	// both dialects. Defaults applied by the component: the change event
	// plus form encoding, so every filter field in the form serializes.
	// Target/PushURL render for htmx only; Datastar targeting is
	// response-driven — wrap the handler in wire.Handler.
	Wire *wire.Action
	// Target is the results-region selector the response swaps into
	// (htmx hx-target). Empty leaves htmx's default (the form itself).
	Target string
	// Sticky renders the top-anchored shell (sticky top-0, z-20, border,
	// solid background) — the pattern for bars above long result lists.
	Sticky bool
	// ResetText renders a ghost Reset link to the unfiltered Action URL
	// when non-empty ("Reset" via DefaultFilterBarProps).
	ResetText string
	// NoPushURL opts out of pushing the filtered URL (the zero value
	// pushes, so filtered views are shareable — the list-page convention;
	// htmx dialect only).
	NoPushURL bool
}

// DefaultFilterBarProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultFilterBarProps() FilterBarProps {
	return FilterBarProps{ //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // intentionally minimal defaults
		ResetText: "Reset",
	}
}

// filterBarTrigger is the composite auto-submit trigger: selects and
// checkboxes re-submit; text inputs do NOT (they change on blur — wire
// search inputs through FilterInput's debounced keyup instead). This is
// footgun #2 of docs/recipes/horizontal-filter-bar.md, encoded.
const filterBarTrigger = "change from:find select, change from:find input[type=checkbox]"

// filterBarIsHTMX reports whether the effective wiring speaks the htmx
// dialect (the default transport per ADR-0030).
func filterBarIsHTMX(props FilterBarProps) bool {
	if props.Wire == nil || props.Wire.URL == "" {
		return true
	}

	return props.Wire.Transport != wire.TransportDatastar
}

// filterBarAttributes renders the auto-submit wiring for the form element.
//
//   - Wire set: the wire action with the component's form defaults (change
//     event + form encoding), with the htmx-dialect trigger replaced by the
//     bar's composite clause. The consumer's action is never mutated
//     (value-receiver builders).
//   - Wire unset, Action set: default htmx wiring derived from Action.
//   - Neither: nil (inert form).
func filterBarAttributes(props FilterBarProps) templ.Attributes {
	if props.Wire != nil && props.Wire.URL != "" {
		attrs := props.Wire.WithFormDefaults(wire.EventChange).Attributes()
		if attrs == nil {
			return nil
		}

		if props.Wire.Transport != wire.TransportDatastar {
			attrs["hx-trigger"] = filterBarTrigger
			if !props.NoPushURL {
				attrs["hx-push-url"] = "true"
			}
		}

		return attrs
	}

	if props.Action == "" {
		return nil
	}

	attrs := templ.Attributes{
		"hx-get":     props.Action,
		"hx-trigger": filterBarTrigger,
	}

	if props.Target != "" {
		attrs["hx-target"] = props.Target
	}

	if !props.NoPushURL {
		attrs["hx-push-url"] = "true"
	}

	return attrs
}

# ── forms/filter_bar.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// filterBarNoscriptButtonClass is the Apply button styling, shared with
// FilterDropdown's noscript fallback (compact primary button).
const filterBarNoscriptButtonClass = "inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-blue-600 dark:focus-visible:outline-blue-500"

// FilterBar renders the horizontal auto-submit filter row for list pages.
//
//	@forms.FilterBar(forms.DefaultFilterBarProps()) {
//		@forms.FilterDropdown(forms.FilterDropdownProps{
//			Name: "status", Label: "Status", HxGet: "/users", HxTarget: "#results",
//			Options: []forms.SelectOption{{Value: "", Label: "All"}, {Value: "active", Label: "Active"}},
//		})
//	}
//
// Dual-transport: set Wire instead of relying on the Action-derived htmx
// defaults (see FilterBarProps.Wire). Children compose any filter controls —
// selects, checkboxes, search inputs, and the hidden inputs that keep
// link-driven query params in the form (recipe footgun #1).
templ FilterBar(props FilterBarProps) {
	{{
		wiring := filterBarAttributes(props)
		wired := wiring != nil
		indicatorID := utils.EnsureID("filter-bar", props.ID) + "-indicator"
		barClass := "flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3"
		if props.Sticky {
			barClass = utils.Class("sticky top-0 z-20 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900", props.Class)
		} else {
			barClass = utils.Class(barClass, props.Class)
		}
	}}
	<form
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		method="get"
		if props.Action != "" {
			action={ templ.SafeURL(props.Action) }
		}
		class={ barClass }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ wiring... }
		if wired && filterBarIsHTMX(props) {
			hx-indicator={ "#" + indicatorID }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		{ children... }
		if props.ResetText != "" && props.Action != "" {
			<a
				href={ templ.SafeURL(props.Action) }
				class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 dark:text-gray-400 dark:hover:text-gray-200 dark:focus-visible:ring-blue-400"
			>
				{ props.ResetText }
			</a>
		}
		if wired && filterBarIsHTMX(props) {
			<span
				id={ indicatorID }
				class="htmx-indicator inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500"
			>
				Loading…
			</span>
		}
		<noscript>
			<button type="submit" class={ filterBarNoscriptButtonClass }>Apply</button>
		</noscript>
	</form>
}

# ── forms/filter_chips.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// FilterChips component: zero-JS link-based filter chips — filter state
// lives in the URL, chips are plain links, no JavaScript anywhere (SEO- and
// crawler-friendly). Extracted from nsfw-classifier's historyChip
// (history_page.templ:105, 2026-10-10 analysis, TODO_LIST #391).
package forms

import (
	"maps"
	"net/url"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// FilterChip is one filter link. The consumer owns the href — filter state
// is query-param truth, and only the consumer knows the page's full param
// set (cursors, lanes, sibling filters). Build common toggles with
// FilterToggleHref.
type FilterChip struct {
	// Label is the visible chip text.
	Label string
	// Href is the link target carrying the chip's filter state.
	Href string
	// Active marks the currently applied filter. The active chip renders
	// aria-current="true" and the filled style; keeping the link (like the
	// extraction source) is honest about the current state.
	Active bool
}

// FilterChipsProps configures a row of zero-JS filter chips.
type FilterChipsProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	// Chips renders left to right. Provide an "All" chip (empty-value href)
	// so users can clear the filter without JavaScript.
	Chips []FilterChip
}

// DefaultFilterChipsProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultFilterChipsProps() FilterChipsProps {
	return FilterChipsProps{} //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // no non-zero defaults
}

// FilterToggleHref builds a chip href that sets key=value on basePath,
// preserving every other query param; an empty value REMOVES the key (the
// "All" chip). Values are URL-escaped via url.Values — injection-safe by
// construction.
//
//	href := forms.FilterToggleHref("/history", r.URL.Query(), "source", "upload")
func FilterToggleHref(basePath string, params url.Values, key, value string) string {
	values := make(url.Values, len(params))
	maps.Copy(values, params)

	if value == "" {
		values.Del(key)
	} else {
		values.Set(key, value)
	}

	encoded := values.Encode()
	if encoded == "" {
		return basePath
	}

	return basePath + "?" + encoded
}

// filterChipClass resolves the chip style: filled when active, outlined
// otherwise.
func filterChipClass(active bool) string {
	if active {
		return "border-blue-600 bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 dark:border-blue-500 dark:bg-blue-500 dark:text-white dark:hover:bg-blue-400"
	}

	return "border-gray-300 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"
}

// filterChipClasses joins the shared chip shape with the state style.
func filterChipClasses(active bool, extra string) string {
	return utils.Class(
		"rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-sm transition-colors motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0",
		filterChipClass(active),
		extra,
	)
}

// filterChipsLabel is the accessible name for a chip row whose consumer set
// neither AriaLabel nor a visible heading — chip rows are filter groups and
// must be named.
const filterChipsLabel = "Filters"

# ── forms/filter_chips.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// FilterChips renders a row of zero-JS filter chips — plain links whose
// hrefs carry the filter state (query-param truth, crawler-friendly, no
// JavaScript).
//
//	@forms.FilterChips(forms.FilterChipsProps{
//		Chips: []forms.FilterChip{
//			{Label: "All", Href: forms.FilterToggleHref("/history", q, "source", "")},
//			{Label: "Uploads", Href: forms.FilterToggleHref("/history", q, "source", "upload"), Active: true},
//		},
//	})
templ FilterChips(props FilterChipsProps) {
	{{
		label := props.AriaLabel
		if label == "" {
			label = filterChipsLabel
		}
	}}
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2", props.Class) }
		role="group"
		aria-label={ label }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		for _, chip := range props.Chips {
			<a
				href={ templ.SafeURL(chip.Href) }
				class={ filterChipClasses(chip.Active, "") }
				if chip.Active {
					aria-current="true"
				}
			>
				{ chip.Label }
			</a>
		}
	</div>
}

# ── forms/filter_dropdown.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/wire"
)

// FilterDropdownProps configures a compact select dropdown purpose-built
// for HTMX filter bars. On change, it auto-submits a GET request to HxGet
// and swaps the results into HxTarget — no manual form wiring needed.
//
// Typical use: a filter bar with status, date-range, and sort dropdowns.
// Each FilterDropdown independently triggers a server-side filter refresh
// via HTMX without a full page reload or a wrapping <form>.
type FilterDropdownProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name    string
	Label   string
	Options []SelectOption
