	// Value pre-selects the option whose Value matches. Use this to
	// preserve the user's last filter selection across HTMX re-renders.
	Value string
	// HxGet is the server endpoint to fetch filtered results.
	HxGet string
	// HxTarget is the CSS selector for the element to swap results into.
	HxTarget string
	// HxSwap controls how the response is swapped (default: "innerHTML").
	HxSwap string
	// HxTrigger overrides the default "change" trigger. Use e.g.
	// "change delay:500ms" for debounced filtering.
	HxTrigger string
	// HxInclude is a CSS selector or keyword (e.g. "closest form") to
	// include additional form values in the request.
	HxInclude string
	// HxIndicator is a CSS selector for the element to show while loading.
	HxIndicator string
	// HelpText shows a small caption below the select.
	HelpText string
	// Action is the no-JS fallback the wired form submits to via GET. When
	// Wire is set, the component wraps the select in a GET form with a
	// <noscript> Apply button so browsers without JavaScript still apply the
	// filter (with a full-page load). Ignored when Wire is unset.
	Action string
	// Wire, when set with a non-empty URL, owns the auto-submit wiring in
	// both dialects and the legacy HxGet/HxTarget/HxSwap/HxTrigger fields are
	// ignored (HxInclude/HxIndicator still render — they are htmx-dialect
	// extras outside the wire common subset, ADR-0036). Defaults applied by
	// the component: Event resolves to change and ContentType to form
	// encoding, so the request carries the filter fields as query parameters
	// via the wrapping form. Wire.Target renders for htmx only; Datastar
	// targeting is response-driven — wrap the handler in wire.Handler. An
	// empty Wire.URL wires nothing (plain HTMX select).
	Wire *wire.Action
}

// DefaultFilterDropdownProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultFilterDropdownProps() FilterDropdownProps {
	return FilterDropdownProps{}
}

// filterDropdownFallbackName is the accessible name for a FilterDropdown whose
// consumer set neither Label nor AriaLabel — a select must never render
// unnamed (axe select-name).
const filterDropdownFallbackName = "Filter"

// filterDropdownInputClass returns the Tailwind classes for the select element.
func filterDropdownInputClass() string {
	return "block rounded-md border-0 py-1.5 ps-3 pe-8 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 dark:ring-gray-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset focus:ring-blue-600 dark:focus:ring-blue-500 caret-blue-600 dark:caret-blue-400"
}

// filterDropdownPreselect returns a copy of opts with the option matching value
// marked as Selected. All other Selected flags are cleared. When value is empty,
// opts is returned unchanged.
func filterDropdownPreselect(opts []SelectOption, value string) []SelectOption {
	if value == "" {
		return opts
	}
	out := make([]SelectOption, len(opts))
	copy(out, opts)
	for i := range out {
		out[i].Selected = out[i].Value == value
	}
	return out
}

// FilterDropdown renders a compact labeled select with HTMX auto-submit.
// It is designed for filter bars where each dropdown independently triggers
// a server-side filter refresh on change.
//
//	@forms.FilterDropdown(forms.FilterDropdownProps{
//	   Name:    "status",
//	   Label:   "Status",
//	   Value:   "active",
//	   HxGet:   "/api/users",
//	   HxTarget: "#user-list",
//	   Options: []forms.SelectOption{
//	     {Value: "", Label: "All"},
//	     {Value: "active", Label: "Active"},
//	     {Value: "inactive", Label: "Inactive"},
//	   },
//	})
templ FilterDropdown(props FilterDropdownProps) {
	{{ opts := normalizeSelectOptions(filterDropdownPreselect(props.Options, props.Value)) }}
	{{ wired := wireHosted(props.Wire, wire.EventChange) }}
	{{ isWired := props.Wire != nil && props.Wire.URL != "" }}
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	{{ selectName := utils.Ternary(props.AriaLabel != "", props.AriaLabel, utils.Ternary(props.Label != "", props.Label, filterDropdownFallbackName)) }}
	<div class={ utils.Class("inline-flex flex-col", props.Class) } { props.Attrs... }>
		if isWired {
			<form
				if props.Action != "" {
					action={ props.Action }
				}
				method="GET"
				class="inline-flex flex-col"
			>
				if props.Label != "" {
					<label for={ props.ID } class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
						{ props.Label }
					</label>
				}
				<select
					name={ props.Name }
					id={ props.ID }
					class={ filterDropdownInputClass() }
					{ wired... }
					if props.HxInclude != "" {
						hx-include={ props.HxInclude }
					}
					if props.HxIndicator != "" {
						hx-indicator={ props.HxIndicator }
					}
					aria-label={ selectName }
				>
					@filterDropdownOptions(opts)
				</select>
				<noscript>
					<button type="submit" class="mt-2 inline-flex items-center rounded-md bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-blue-600 dark:focus-visible:outline-blue-500">
						Apply
					</button>
				</noscript>
				if props.HelpText != "" {
					<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{ props.HelpText }</p>
				}
			</form>
		} else {
			if props.Label != "" {
				<label for={ props.ID } class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
					{ props.Label }
				</label>
			}
			<select
				name={ props.Name }
				id={ props.ID }
				class={ filterDropdownInputClass() }
				hx-get={ templ.SafeURL(props.HxGet) }
				hx-target={ props.HxTarget }
				hx-trigger={ utils.Ternary(props.HxTrigger != "", props.HxTrigger, "change") }
				if props.HxSwap != "" {
					hx-swap={ props.HxSwap }
				}
				if props.HxInclude != "" {
					hx-include={ props.HxInclude }
				}
				if props.HxIndicator != "" {
					hx-indicator={ props.HxIndicator }
				}
				aria-label={ selectName }
			>
				@filterDropdownOptions(opts)
			</select>
			if props.HelpText != "" {
				<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{ props.HelpText }</p>
			}
		}
	</div>
}

// filterDropdownOptions renders the shared option loop for both FilterDropdown
// branches (the legacy HTMX select and the wired dual-transport form).
// Duplicated branch inners are required by the templ DSL — a tag cannot open
// in one if-branch and close in another (see ADR-0009).
templ filterDropdownOptions(opts []SelectOption) {
	for _, opt := range opts {
		<option
			value={ opt.Value }
			if opt.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if opt.Selected {
				selected
			}
		>{ opt.Label }</option>
	}
}

# ── forms/filter_input.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/wire"
)

// FilterInputProps configures a debounced search/filter text input that
// auto-submits to a server endpoint as the user types — under either
// transport. It is the input sibling of FilterDropdown: purpose-built for
// filter bars, result tables, and live search regions.
//
// The component always renders a `<search>` landmark containing a GET form,
// so a no-JS browser still submits natively and both runtimes serialize the
// field as a query parameter (the form encoding path — see
// docs/recipes/server-side-validation.md for the wire contract).
type FilterInputProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	// Name is the field name submitted with the request (e.g. "q").
	Name string
	// Label shows a visible caption above the input. When empty, set
	// AriaLabel so screen readers can still announce the field.
	Label string
	// Value pre-fills the input. Use this to preserve the query across
	// server re-renders of the filter bar.
	Value string
	// Placeholder shows hint text inside the empty input.
	Placeholder string
	// HelpText shows a small caption below the input, linked via
	// aria-describedby.
	HelpText string
	// Action is the no-JS fallback the form submits to via GET. When empty,
	// the form has no action attribute (submits to the current URL).
	Action string
	// DebounceMS delays the wired request until typing pauses for this many
	// milliseconds. Default 300 via DefaultFilterInputProps; 0 disables the
	// debounce (a request fires on every keystroke). htmx renders it as the
	// `input changed delay:<n>ms` trigger; Datastar as the
	// `__debounce.<n>ms` event modifier (spelling decoded from the pinned
	// v1.0.3 bundle — see docs/datastar-runtime-facts.md).
	DebounceMS int
	// Wire, when set with a non-empty URL, submits the input via the
	// configured transport instead of a full page load (see the wire
	// package, ADR-0036). Defaults applied by the component: Event resolves
	// to input and ContentType to form encoding, so the request carries
	// `?<Name>=<Value>` as a query parameter. Wire.Target renders for htmx
	// only (hx-target); Datastar targeting is response-driven — wrap the
	// handler in wire.Handler. An empty Wire.URL wires nothing.
	Wire *wire.Action
}

// DefaultFilterInputProps returns sensible defaults (300ms debounce).
func DefaultFilterInputProps() FilterInputProps {
	return FilterInputProps{
		DebounceMS: 300,
	}
}

// filterInputClass returns the Tailwind classes for the input element.
func filterInputClass() string {
	return "block w-full rounded-md border-0 py-1.5 ps-3 pe-8 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 dark:ring-gray-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset focus:ring-blue-600 dark:focus:ring-blue-500 caret-blue-600 dark:caret-blue-400 placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:placeholder:text-gray-500"
}

// filterInputWireAttributes renders the wiring for a FilterInput. The
// component-level DebounceMS always wins — it is this component's single
// source of truth for the trigger delay. Event and ContentType defaults
// (input / form encoding) come from wire.Action.WithFormDefaults via
// wireHosted. An empty URL wires nothing (inert form).
func filterInputWireAttributes(w *wire.Action, debounceMS int) templ.Attributes {
	if w == nil {
		return nil
	}

	action := *w
	action.DebounceMS = debounceMS

	return wireHosted(&action, wire.EventInput)
}

// FilterInput renders a debounced search/filter input that auto-submits as
// the user types. The `<search>` landmark wraps a GET form, so the request
// carries the field as a query parameter under both transports and the
// form still submits natively without JavaScript.
//
//	@forms.FilterInput(forms.FilterInputProps{
//	   Name:        "q",
//	   Label:       "Search users",
//	   Placeholder: "Type to filter…",
//	   Wire:        &wire.Action{URL: "/api/users/search", Target: "#user-list"},
//	})
templ FilterInput(props FilterInputProps) {
	{{ inputID := utils.EnsureID("filter-input", props.ID) }}
	{{ wired := filterInputWireAttributes(props.Wire, props.DebounceMS) }}
	<search>
		<form
			if props.Action != "" {
				action={ props.Action }
			}
			method="GET"
			class={ utils.Class("inline-flex flex-col", props.Class) }
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			if props.Label != "" {
				<label for={ inputID } class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
					{ props.Label }
				</label>
			}
			<input
				type="search"
				id={ inputID }
				name={ props.Name }
				value={ props.Value }
				if props.Placeholder != "" {
					placeholder={ props.Placeholder }
				}
				class={ filterInputClass() }
				if props.HelpText != "" {
					aria-describedby={ inputID + "-help" }
				}
				if props.AriaLabel != "" {
					aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
				}
				{ wired... }
			/>
			if props.HelpText != "" {
				<p id={ inputID + "-help" } class="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{ props.HelpText }</p>
			}
		</form>
	</search>
}

# ── forms/form.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils/wire"
)

// FormMethod defines the HTTP method for a form.
// HTML forms only support GET and POST (per the HTML spec).
// For transport-agnostic requests using other verbs (PUT, DELETE, PATCH),
// keep Method as the no-JS fallback (typically FormPost) and set Wire:
//
//	forms.FormProps{
//	    Method: forms.FormPost,
//	    Wire:   &wire.Action{Method: wire.MethodPut, URL: "/api/item/123"},
//	}
type FormMethod string

const (
	FormGet  FormMethod = "GET"
	FormPost FormMethod = "POST"
)

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level validation set for form methods
var validFormMethods = map[FormMethod]bool{
	FormGet: true, FormPost: true,
}

// formMethod returns the validated HTTP method. Unknown or empty values fall
// back to GET — matching the HTML spec default for forms and the map+fallback
// convention used by all other enums in the library.
func formMethod(m FormMethod) string {
	if m == "" || !validFormMethods[m] {
		return string(FormGet)
	}
	return string(m)
}

// FormEnctype is a typed enum for the form's enctype attribute — how field
// values are encoded in the POST body. Both runtimes honor it: htmx
// serializes natively per enctype, and the pinned Datastar bundle sends a
// FormData body exactly when enctype is multipart (see
// docs/datastar-runtime-facts.md).
type FormEnctype string

const (
	// FormEnctypeUrlencoded is the HTML default
	// (application/x-www-form-urlencoded). The zero value resolves here.
	FormEnctypeUrlencoded FormEnctype = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
	// FormEnctypeMultipart is multipart/form-data — required for file
	// uploads (input type=file).
	FormEnctypeMultipart FormEnctype = "multipart/form-data"
)

// FormEnctypeIsValid reports whether e is a recognized FormEnctype. The zero
// value counts as valid: it means "use the HTML default".
func FormEnctypeIsValid(e FormEnctype) bool {
	return e == FormEnctypeUrlencoded || e == FormEnctypeMultipart || e == ""
}

// formEnctype resolves the zero value (and unknown values, defensively) to
// the HTML default.
func formEnctype(e FormEnctype) string {
	if e == FormEnctypeMultipart {
		return string(FormEnctypeMultipart)
	}

	return string(FormEnctypeUrlencoded)
}

// FormLayout is a typed enum controlling the visual layout of a Form. Unknown
// values fall back to FormLayoutStack. See ADR-0016 for when to use each.
type FormLayout string

const (
	// FormLayoutStack — vertical column with space-y-6 between fields. The
	// default; use for data-entry forms where each field gets its own row.
	FormLayoutStack FormLayout = "stack"
	// FormLayoutInline — horizontal flex-wrap row with gap-3. Use for filter
	// bars and toolbars where fields are short and should sit on one line.
	// Deprecated in favor of FormLayoutGrid when label alignment matters
	// across wrapped rows (flex-wrap misaligns labels).
	//
	// Width contract: fields size to their content, never to the form's
	// full width. This works because field wrappers are shrink-to-fit flex
	// items — do NOT wrap fields in `w-full` containers here, and prefer
	// short inputs (the w-full on the input element itself resolves to the
	// intrinsic width). Pinned by the browser guard
	// visualtest.TestFormLayoutInlineWidthContract.
	FormLayoutInline FormLayout = "inline"
	// FormLayoutGrid — horizontal grid with auto-sized label column and a
	// flexible value column. Use for settings forms and admin panels where
	// labels must stay aligned even when fields wrap.
	// Emits: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-4 gap-y-3
	FormLayoutGrid FormLayout = "grid"
	// FormLayoutDefault is the canonical default (Stack).
	FormLayoutDefault FormLayout = FormLayoutStack
)

// FormLayoutIsValid reports whether l is a recognized FormLayout.
func FormLayoutIsValid(l FormLayout) bool {
	return l == FormLayoutStack || l == FormLayoutInline || l == FormLayoutGrid
}

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for form layouts
var formLayoutLookup = map[FormLayout]string{
	FormLayoutStack:  "space-y-6",
	FormLayoutInline: "flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3",
	FormLayoutGrid:   "grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-4 gap-y-3",
}

// formLayoutLookupContainer mirrors formLayoutLookup with @container-keyed
// breakpoints (@sm:) so container-aware forms respond to their parent's width
// instead of the viewport. Only FormLayoutGrid has a breakpoint — Stack and
// Inline are width-agnostic. See ADR-0018.
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for container-aware variant
var formLayoutLookupContainer = map[FormLayout]string{
	FormLayoutStack:  "space-y-6",
	FormLayoutInline: "flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3",
	FormLayoutGrid:   "grid grid-cols-1 @sm:grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-x-4 gap-y-3",
}

// formLayoutClass returns the Tailwind layout class for a FormLayout. Falls
// back to FormLayoutDefault for unknown values. When containerAware is true,
// returns @container-keyed variants so the layout responds to the parent
// container's width, not the viewport.
func formLayoutClass(l FormLayout, containerAware bool) string {
	if containerAware {
		return utils.Lookup(formLayoutLookupContainer, l, formLayoutLookupContainer[FormLayoutDefault])
	}
	return utils.Lookup(formLayoutLookup, l, formLayoutLookup[FormLayoutDefault])
}

// formLayoutEffective resolves the effective FormLayout. When Layout is
// explicitly set (non-empty) and valid, it wins. Otherwise falls back to
// Default.
func formLayoutEffective(props FormProps) FormLayout {
	if props.Layout != "" && FormLayoutIsValid(props.Layout) {
		return props.Layout
	}
	return FormLayoutDefault
}

// FormProps configures a form wrapper
type FormProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Action string
	Method FormMethod
	// Enctype selects the encoding of a POST body. Zero value (and unknown
	// values) resolve to the HTML default, urlencoded; set
	// FormEnctypeMultipart for file uploads. Under both transports the
	// runtime honors it: htmx serializes natively, the pinned Datastar
	// bundle sends a FormData body exactly when enctype is multipart.
	Enctype       FormEnctype
	CSRFToken     string
	CSRFTokenName string // Hidden input name attribute; defaults to "csrf_token"
	// Layout selects the visual layout: Stack (default), Inline (horizontal
	// flex-wrap), or Grid (aligned label/value columns).
	Layout FormLayout
	// Validate, when true, adds hx-validate="true" for HTML5 constraint
	// validation before HTMX submit.
	Validate bool
	// DirtyGuard opts this form into the unsaved-changes guard: render
	// forms.DirtyGuard once on the page and the browser warns before
	// leaving with unsaved changes in this form (see DirtyGuardProps).
	DirtyGuard bool
	// NoValidate renders the HTML novalidate attribute, disabling the
	// browser's native constraint validation on submit. Symmetric across
	// transports: under htmx it suppresses the built-in reportValidity UI;
	// under Datastar it lifts the pinned bundle's form-encoding validation
	// gate (the runtime only calls checkValidity when the form lacks
	// novalidate), letting server-side validation own the error UX — see
	// docs/recipes/server-side-validation.md. Pair with Validate
	// (hx-validate="true") to keep htmx's pre-submit check while dropping
	// the native tooltips.
	NoValidate bool
	// ContainerAware, when true, wraps the form in a @container div and swaps
	// sm: breakpoint classes for @sm: so the Grid layout responds to the
	// parent container's width, not the viewport. Useful when a form is placed
	// inside a modal, drawer, sidebar, or other constrained layout. Default
	// false (viewport breakpoints). See ADR-0018.
	ContainerAware bool
	// Wire, when set, submits the form via the configured transport instead
	// of a full page load (see the wire package, ADR-0036). The form's fields
	// serialize in both dialects: htmx natively (hx-post + hx-trigger
	// "submit"), Datastar via {contentType: 'form'} on data-on:submit — a
	// runtime capability verified against the pinned v1.0.3 bundle (HTML5
	// validation gates the request, the submitter button's name/value is
	// appended, enctype selects multipart for file uploads, GET carries the
	// fields as query parameters).
	//
	// Field defaults: an unspecified Event resolves to submit, an unspecified
	// ContentType resolves to form encoding (set ContentTypeJSON explicitly to
	// submit Datastar signals instead — then no form fields travel). Method
	// follows wire's zero-value contract (GET) — set MethodPost for mutating
	// submissions, mirroring DefaultFormProps's native Method. Wire.URL
	// replaces Action for the wired request; Action/Method stay as the no-JS
	// fallback. Wire.Target renders only for htmx (hx-target); Datastar
	// targeting is response-driven — wrap the handler in wire.Handler.
	// An empty Wire.URL wires nothing (the form stays a plain HTML form).
	Wire *wire.Action
}

// DefaultFormProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultFormProps() FormProps {
	return FormProps{
		Method:        FormPost,
		CSRFTokenName: "csrf_token",
	}
}

// formWireAttributes renders the wiring for a Form. The shared host defaults
// (an unspecified Event becomes submit — the only event that submits a form,
// and the one Datastar's runtime auto-preventDefaults on form elements — and
// an unspecified ContentType becomes form encoding) live in
// wire.Action.WithFormDefaults; this adapter is the nil-safe component
// boundary only. An empty URL wires nothing (inert HTML form).
func formWireAttributes(w *wire.Action) templ.Attributes {
	return wireHosted(w, wire.EventSubmit)
}

// wireValidateHTMX reports whether hx-validate applies to the form's
// wiring: it is an htmx attribute (pre-submit HTML5 check), meaningless to
// Datastar — where the runtime's form-encoding validation gate handles the
// native check. Unwired forms keep it (the no-JS/htmx default).
func wireValidateHTMX(w *wire.Action) bool {
	return w == nil || w.Transport != wire.TransportDatastar
}

// wireHosted renders a form-hosted action with the host's natural event
// default plus form encoding (wire.Action.WithFormDefaults). Nil stays
// unwired — the shared nil boundary for every form-hosting component.
func wireHosted(w *wire.Action, event wire.Event) templ.Attributes {
	if w == nil {
		return nil
	}

	return w.WithFormDefaults(event).Attributes()
}

// Form renders a form element with optional CSRF token
//
//	@forms.Form(forms.FormProps{Action: "/submit", CSRFToken: "token123"}) {
//		   @forms.Input(forms.InputProps{Name: "email"})
//		}
//
// Dual-transport submit — the same props under either runtime:
//
//	@forms.Form(forms.FormProps{
//		   Wire: &wire.Action{Transport: wire.TransportDatastar, Method: wire.MethodPost, URL: "/api/save"},
//		}) {
//		   @forms.Input(forms.InputProps{Name: "email"})
//		}
templ Form(props FormProps) {
	if props.ContainerAware {
		<div class="@container">
			@formInner(props) {
				{ children... }
			}
		</div>
	} else {
		@formInner(props) {
			{ children... }
		}
	}
}

templ formInner(props FormProps) {
	{{ wired := formWireAttributes(props.Wire) }}
	<form
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		if props.Action != "" {
			action={ props.Action }
		}
		method={ formMethod(props.Method) }
		if props.Enctype == FormEnctypeMultipart {
			enctype={ formEnctype(props.Enctype) }
		}
		if props.Validate && wireValidateHTMX(props.Wire) {
			hx-validate="true"
		}
		if props.NoValidate {
			novalidate
		}
		if props.DirtyGuard {
			data-tc-dirty-guard="true"
		}
		class={ utils.Class(formLayoutClass(formLayoutEffective(props), props.ContainerAware), props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ wired... }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		if props.CSRFToken != "" {
			{{ csrfName := utils.Ternary(props.CSRFTokenName != "", props.CSRFTokenName, "csrf_token") }}
			<input type="hidden" name={ csrfName } value={ props.CSRFToken }/>
		}
		{ children... }
	</form>
}

# ── forms/ids.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// ID sanitization for form field elements.
package forms

import "regexp"

var nonAlphaNum = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9-]`)

// SanitizeID returns a safe HTML ID from arbitrary text.
func SanitizeID(s string) string {
	return nonAlphaNum.ReplaceAllString(s, "-")
}

// HelpTextID returns the HTML ID for a help text element, or "" if id is empty.
func HelpTextID(id string) string {
	if id == "" {
		return ""
	}

	return id + "-help"
}

# ── forms/input.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// InputType defines HTML input types
type InputType string

const (
	InputText     InputType = "text"
	InputEmail    InputType = "email"
	InputPassword InputType = "password"
	InputNumber   InputType = "number"
	InputTel      InputType = "tel"
	InputURL      InputType = "url"
	InputDate     InputType = "date"
	InputTime     InputType = "time"
	InputDatetime InputType = "datetime-local"
	InputSearch   InputType = "search"
	InputHidden   InputType = "hidden"
)

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level validation set for input types
var validInputTypes = map[InputType]bool{
	InputText: true, InputEmail: true, InputPassword: true,
	InputNumber: true, InputTel: true, InputURL: true,
	InputDate: true, InputTime: true, InputDatetime: true,
	InputSearch: true, InputHidden: true,
}

// inputType returns the HTML input type string. Unknown values fall back
// to "text" — matching the HTML spec behavior where unknown types default
// to text. This aligns with the map+fallback convention used by all other
// enums in the library.
func inputType(t InputType) string {
	if t == "" {
		return string(InputText)
	}
	if !validInputTypes[t] {
		return string(InputText)
	}
	return string(t)
}

// enterKeyHintForType maps InputType to the optimal mobile keyboard Enter
// key label. Returns "" when no hint applies (text, password, hidden, date/time).
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Mobile UX lookup table
var enterKeyHintForType = map[InputType]string{
	InputEmail:  "next",
	InputNumber: "next",
	InputTel:    "next",
	InputURL:    "next",
	InputSearch: "search",
}

// inputModeForType maps InputType to the optimal mobile keyboard layout.
// Returns "" when the native type attribute already provides the correct
// keyboard (text, password, date, time, datetime-local, hidden).
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Mobile UX lookup table
var inputModeForType = map[InputType]string{
	InputEmail:  "email",
	InputNumber: "decimal",
	InputTel:    "tel",
	InputURL:    "url",
	InputSearch: "search",
}

// enterKeyHintValue returns the explicit EnterKeyHint if set and valid,
// otherwise falls back to the auto-derived value from InputType. This
// unifies the EnterKeyHint API: Input uses the same EnterKeyHintType enum
// as Textarea, with auto-derivation as a smart default.
func enterKeyHintValue(props InputProps) string {
	if props.EnterKeyHint != "" && EnterKeyHintTypeIsValid(props.EnterKeyHint) {
		return string(props.EnterKeyHint)
	}
	if ekh, ok := enterKeyHintForType[props.Type]; ok {
		return ekh
	}
	return ""
}

// InputProps configures a text input. EnterKeyHint, when set, overrides the
// auto-derived mobile keyboard hint. Uses the same EnterKeyHintType enum as
// Textarea for a unified API across form components.
type InputProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Type         InputType
	Name         string
	Value        string
	Placeholder  string
	Label        string
	Required     bool
	Disabled     bool
	ReadOnly     bool
	AutoFocus    bool
	MaxLength    int
	EnterKeyHint EnterKeyHintType
	Error        string
	HelpText     string
}

// DefaultInputProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultInputProps() InputProps {
	return InputProps{
		Type: InputText,
	}
}

// Input renders a labeled text input with optional error and help text
//
//	@forms.Input(forms.InputProps{
//	   Name: "email",
//	   Type: forms.InputEmail,
//	   Label: "Email address",
//	   Required: true,
//	})
templ Input(props InputProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	if props.Type == InputHidden {
		<input
			type="hidden"
			name={ props.Name }
			id={ props.ID }
			value={ props.Value }
			{ props.Attrs... }
		/>
	} else {
		@FormFieldWrapper(FormFieldProps{ID: props.ID, Label: props.Label, Required: props.Required, Error: props.Error, HelpText: props.HelpText}) {
			if props.Type == InputSearch {
				<search class="relative">
					@inputElement(props)
				</search>
			} else {
				<div class="relative">
					@inputElement(props)
				</div>
			}
		}
	}
}

// inputElement renders the visible <input> element with all shared attributes.
// Extracted per ADR 0010 (2 callers, 30+ lines, clear domain name) to eliminate
// the duplication between the <search> and <div> wrapper branches.
templ inputElement(props InputProps) {
	<input
		type={ inputType(props.Type) }
		name={ props.Name }
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		value={ props.Value }
		if props.Placeholder != "" {
			placeholder={ props.Placeholder }
		}
		if eh := enterKeyHintValue(props); eh != "" {
			enterkeyhint={ eh }
		}
		if im, ok := inputModeForType[props.Type]; ok {
			inputmode={ im }
		}
		class={ utils.Class(baseInputClass(props.Error != ""), props.Class) }
		if props.Required {
			required
			aria-required="true"
		}
		if props.Disabled {
			disabled
		}
		if props.ReadOnly {
			readonly
		}
		if props.AutoFocus {
			autofocus
		}
		if props.MaxLength > 0 {
			maxlength={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.MaxLength) }
		}
		{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	/>
}

// CheckboxProps configures a checkbox input
type CheckboxProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name     string
	Value    string
	Label    string
	Checked  bool
	Required bool
	Disabled bool
	Error    string
	HelpText string
}

// DefaultCheckboxProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultCheckboxProps() CheckboxProps {
	return CheckboxProps{}
}

// checkboxLabel renders the label and optional help text for a checkbox
templ checkboxLabel(id, label, helpMsg string) {
	<div class="ms-3 text-sm leading-6">
		if label != "" {
			if id != "" {
				<label for={ id } class="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{ label }</label>
			} else {
				<span class="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{ label }</span>
			}
		}
		@helpText(id, helpMsg)
	</div>
}

// Checkbox renders a checkbox with label
//
//	@forms.Checkbox(forms.CheckboxProps{Name: "terms", ID: "terms", Label: "I agree to the terms"})
templ Checkbox(props CheckboxProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	<div class="flex items-start">
		<div class="flex h-6 items-center">
			<input
				if props.ID != "" {
					id={ props.ID }
				}
				name={ props.Name }
				if props.Value != "" {
					value={ props.Value }
				}
				type="checkbox"
				class={ utils.Class("h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 focus:ring-blue-600 dark:focus:ring-blue-500 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:checked:bg-blue-600", props.Class) }
				if props.Checked {
					checked
				}
				if props.Required {
					required
					aria-required="true"
				}
				if props.Disabled {
					disabled
				}
				{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
				if props.AriaLabel != "" {
					aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
				}
				{ props.Attrs... }
			/>
		</div>
		@checkboxLabel(props.ID, props.Label, props.HelpText)
	</div>
	@FieldError(props.ID, props.Error)
}

# ── forms/input_classes.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shared Tailwind class strings for form input elements.
package forms

// baseInputClass returns the shared Tailwind classes for text inputs, selects, and textareas.
func baseInputClass(hasError bool) string {
	base := "block w-full rounded-md border-0 px-3 py-1.5 text-gray-900 dark:text-white shadow-xs ring-1 ring-inset placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset sm:text-sm sm:leading-6 transition-colors caret-blue-600 dark:caret-blue-400 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:ring-gray-700 dark:placeholder:text-gray-500"
	if hasError {
		return base + " ring-red-300 focus:ring-red-500 dark:ring-red-700 dark:focus:ring-red-500"
	}

	return base + " ring-gray-300 focus:ring-blue-600 dark:focus:ring-blue-500"
}

# ── forms/input_group.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// InputGroupProps configures an input group with optional left/right addons
//
// Use with Input, Select, or Textarea. When using an addon, add padding
// to the input so the content doesn't overlap:
//   - Left addon  → add "ps-10" to input Class
//   - Right addon → add "pe-10" to input Class
//   - Both        → add "ps-10 pe-10"
type InputGroupProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	LeftAddon  templ.Component
	RightAddon templ.Component
}

// DefaultInputGroupProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultInputGroupProps() InputGroupProps {
	return InputGroupProps{}
}

// InputGroupPaddingClass returns the appropriate padding class for an input
// that lives inside an InputGroup with the given addons. Call this from your
// input's Class field to avoid manual padding:
//
//	@forms.InputGroup(forms.InputGroupProps{LeftAddon: icon}) {
//	   @forms.Input(forms.InputProps{Class: forms.InputGroupPaddingClass(true, false)})
//	}
func InputGroupPaddingClass(left, right bool) string {
	switch {
	case left && right:
		return "ps-10 pe-10"
	case left:
		return "ps-10"
	case right:
		return "pe-10"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

// InputGroup renders a form control with optional left/right addons.
// Addons are absolutely positioned inside the input area.
//
//	@forms.InputGroup(forms.InputGroupProps{
//	   LeftAddon: icons.Icon(icons.Search, "h-5 w-5 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500"),
//	}) {
//	   @forms.Input(forms.InputProps{Class: "ps-10"})
//	}
templ InputGroup(props InputGroupProps) {
	<div
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("relative flex items-center", props.Class) }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		if props.LeftAddon != nil {
			<div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 inset-s-0 flex items-center ps-3">
				@props.LeftAddon
			</div>
		}
		<div class="w-full">
			{ children... }
		</div>
		if props.RightAddon != nil {
			<div class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 inset-e-0 flex items-center pe-3">
				@props.RightAddon
			</div>
		}
	</div>
}

# ── forms/label.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

// Label renders a form label with optional required indicator
//
//	@forms.Label("email", "Email address", true)
templ Label(forID, text string, required bool) {
	<label
		if forID != "" {
			for={ forID }
		}
		class="block text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
	>
		{ text }
		if required {
			<span class="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 ms-0.5" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
		}
	</label>
}

// helpText renders the shared help text paragraph for form fields
templ helpText(id, text string) {
	if text != "" {
		<p
			if HelpTextID(id) != "" {
				id={ HelpTextID(id) }
			}
			class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
		>{ text }</p>
	}
}

// FieldError renders a field-level validation error
//
//	@forms.FieldError("email", "This field is required")
templ FieldError(fieldID, message string) {
	if message != "" {
		<p
			class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600 dark:text-red-400"
			role="alert"
			if fieldID != "" {
				id={ fieldID + errorIDSuffix }
			}
		>{ message }</p>
	}
}

// FormFieldProps configures the standard form field wrapper structure.
// Used by FormFieldWrapper to DRY up all form control components.
type FormFieldProps struct {
	ID       string
	Label    string
	Required bool
	Error    string
	HelpText string
}

// FormFieldWrapper renders the standard form field structure:
// optional Label, children (input/select/textarea), optional Error, optional HelpText.
// Use this to DRY up all form control components.
//
//	@forms.FormFieldWrapper(forms.FormFieldProps{ID: "email", Label: "Email", Required: true, Error: "Invalid", HelpText: "Use work email"}) {
//	   <input type="email" name="email" />
//	}
templ FormFieldWrapper(props FormFieldProps) {
	if props.Label != "" {
		@Label(props.ID, props.Label, props.Required)
	}
	{ children... }
	@FieldError(props.ID, props.Error)
	if props.HelpText != "" {
		@helpText(props.ID, props.HelpText)
	}
}

# ── forms/radio.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Radio and RadioGroup component types and helpers.
package forms

import (
	"github.com/a-h/templ"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// RadioProps configures a single radio button input.
type RadioProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	Name     string
	Value    string
	Label    string
	Checked  bool
	Required bool
	Disabled bool
}

// DefaultRadioProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultRadioProps() RadioProps {
	return RadioProps{} //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // intentionally minimal defaults
}

// RadioOption represents a single option in a radio group.
type RadioOption struct {
	Value    string
	Label    string
	Checked  bool
	Disabled bool
}

// RadioGroupProps configures a group of radio buttons.
type RadioGroupProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	Name     string
	Label    string // renders as <legend>
	Options  []RadioOption
	Inline   bool   // horizontal layout
	Error    string // group-level error
	HelpText string
	Required bool
}

// DefaultRadioGroupProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultRadioGroupProps() RadioGroupProps {
	return RadioGroupProps{} //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // intentionally minimal defaults
}

// radioItemProps builds a RadioProps for an option within a group.
// Auto-generates the ID from the group ID and option value.
func radioItemProps(groupID, name string, opt RadioOption, required bool, ariaAttrs templ.Attributes) RadioProps {
	p := RadioProps{ //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // BaseProps.ID set conditionally below
		Name:     name,
		Value:    opt.Value,
		Label:    opt.Label,
		Checked:  opt.Checked,
		Required: required,
		Disabled: opt.Disabled,
	}
	if groupID == "" {
		groupID = name
	}

	p.ID = groupID + "-" + SanitizeID(opt.Value)

	if len(ariaAttrs) > 0 {
		p.Attrs = ariaAttrs
	}

	return p
}

# ── forms/radio.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// fieldID derives the DOM id used for label/control association: the explicit
// ID, falling back to the field Name. A labeled control without an id can
// never be associated with its label (invalid for="" or no association at
// all) — an axe `label`/`select-name` critical violation and a WCAG 1.3.1 /
// 4.1.2 failure. Name is the natural fallback: it is required for form
// submission anyway, so the derived id stays deterministic across re-renders.
func fieldID(id, name string) string {
	if id != "" {
		return id
	}

	return name
}

// radioInputClass returns the shared Tailwind classes for radio inputs
func radioInputClass() string {
	return "h-4 w-4 border-gray-300 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 focus:ring-blue-600 dark:focus:ring-blue-500 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:checked:bg-blue-600"
}

// Radio renders a single radio button with label
//
//	@forms.Radio(forms.RadioProps{
//	   ID: "plan-pro",
//	   Name: "plan",
//	   Value: "pro",
//	   Label: "Pro Plan",
//	   Checked: true,
//	})
templ Radio(props RadioProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	<div class={ utils.Class("flex items-center", props.Class) }>
		<input
			type="radio"
			name={ props.Name }
			value={ props.Value }
			id={ props.ID }
			class={ radioInputClass() }
			if props.Checked {
				checked
			}
			if props.Required {
				required
			}
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		/>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<label
				for={ props.ID }
				class="ms-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
			>
				{ props.Label }
			</label>
		}
	</div>
}

// RadioGroup renders a fieldset of radio buttons with legend, error, and help text
//
//	@forms.RadioGroup(forms.RadioGroupProps{
//	   Name: "plan",
//	   Label: "Select a plan",
//	   Options: []forms.RadioOption{
//	     {Value: "free", Label: "Free"},
//	     {Value: "pro", Label: "Pro"},
//	   },
//	})
templ RadioGroup(props RadioGroupProps) {
	{{ errorAttrs := ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), "")) }}
	<fieldset
		if props.ID != "" {
			id={ props.ID }
		}
		class={ utils.Class("", props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		if props.Required {
			aria-required="true"
		}
		{ errorAttrs... }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<legend class="block text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
				{ props.Label }
				if props.Required {
					<span class="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 ms-0.5" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
				}
			</legend>
		}
		<div class={ utils.Ternary(props.Inline, "mt-2 flex space-x-6", "mt-2 space-y-2") }>
			for _, opt := range props.Options {
				@Radio(radioItemProps(props.ID, props.Name, opt, props.Required, errorAttrs))
			}
		</div>
		if props.Error != "" {
			@FieldError(props.ID, props.Error)
		}
		if props.HelpText != "" {
			@helpText(props.ID, props.HelpText)
		}
	</fieldset>
}

# ── forms/rating.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// RatingSize controls the visual size of rating stars.
type RatingSize string

const (
	RatingSizeSM RatingSize = "sm"
	RatingSizeMD RatingSize = "md" // default
	RatingSizeLG RatingSize = "lg"
)

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table
var ratingSizeLookup = map[RatingSize]string{
	RatingSizeSM: "h-4 w-4",
	RatingSizeMD: "h-5 w-5",
	RatingSizeLG: "h-6 w-6",
}

// RatingSizeIsValid reports whether v is one of the defined RatingSize constants.
func RatingSizeIsValid(v RatingSize) bool {
	_, ok := ratingSizeLookup[v]
	return ok
}

func ratingSizeClass(s RatingSize) string {
	return utils.Lookup(ratingSizeLookup, s, ratingSizeLookup[RatingSizeMD])
}

// RatingProps configures an interactive star rating component.
// Uses radio inputs under the hood for full keyboard accessibility.
type RatingProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name     string
	Value    int // current rating (0 = unrated)
	Max      int // maximum stars (default: 5)
	Size     RatingSize
	ReadOnly bool // display-only mode (no inputs)
	Required bool
	Label    string
	HelpText string
}

// DefaultRatingProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultRatingProps() RatingProps {
	return RatingProps{
		Max:  5,
		Size: RatingSizeMD,
	}
}

// Rating renders an accessible star rating using radio inputs.
// Each star is a labeled radio button with keyboard navigation.
// In ReadOnly mode, renders a static display with aria-label.
//
//	@forms.Rating(forms.RatingProps{
//	   Name:  "quality",
//	   Value: 4,
//	   Max:   5,
//	})
templ Rating(props RatingProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	{{
		maxStars := props.Max
		if maxStars <= 0 {
			maxStars = 5
		}
	}}
	<div class={ utils.Class("space-y-1", props.Class) } { props.Attrs... }>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<span class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
				{ props.Label }
				if props.Required {
					<span class="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 ms-0.5" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
				}
			</span>
		}
		<div
			class={ utils.Ternary(props.ReadOnly, "inline-flex items-center gap-0.5", "inline-flex flex-row-reverse items-center gap-0.5") }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			role={ utils.Ternary(props.ReadOnly, "img", "radiogroup") }
			aria-label={ utils.Ternary(props.AriaLabel != "", props.AriaLabel, utils.Ternary(props.Label != "", props.Label, "Rating")) }
			if props.Required && !props.ReadOnly {
				aria-required="true"
			}
		>
			if props.ReadOnly {
				for i := 1; i <= maxStars; i++ {
					if i <= props.Value {
						@icons.Icon(icons.Star, ratingSizeClass(props.Size)+" text-amber-400 dark:text-amber-400")
					} else {
						@icons.Icon(icons.Star, ratingSizeClass(props.Size)+" text-gray-300 dark:text-gray-600")
					}
				}
				<span class="sr-only">{ fmt.Sprintf("%d out of %d", props.Value, maxStars) }</span>
			} else {
				for i := 1; i <= maxStars; i++ {
					<input
						type="radio"
						name={ props.Name }
						value={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", i) }
						id={ fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", props.ID, i) }
						class="sr-only peer"
						if i == props.Value {
							checked
						}
						if props.Required && i == 1 {
							required
						}
					/>
					<label
						for={ fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", props.ID, i) }
						class={ ratingStarLabelClass() }
					>
						<span class="sr-only">{ fmt.Sprintf("%d star%s", i, pluralStars(i)) }</span>
						@icons.Icon(icons.Star, ratingSizeClass(props.Size))
					</label>
				}
			}
		</div>
		if props.HelpText != "" {
			@helpText(props.ID, props.HelpText)
		}
	</div>
}

// ratingStarLabelClass returns the interactive star label classes. Color,
// hover, checked-fill, and focus-ring utilities live on the <label> (a sibling
// of the hidden radio .peer) rather than the nested <svg> so that Tailwind's
// peer-checked combinator (~) resolves: the checked radio fills itself and
// every label after it in DOM order, which flex-row-reverse maps to the
// correct left-to-right ★★★☆☆ visual. The SVG inherits color via
// currentColor. Forward DOM order (1..N) keeps radiogroup arrow-key direction
// increasing in value per the WAI-ARIA radiogroup pattern.
func ratingStarLabelClass() string {
	return "inline-flex cursor-pointer rounded text-gray-300 dark:text-gray-600 peer-checked:text-amber-400 dark:peer-checked:text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 dark:hover:text-amber-300 peer-focus-visible:text-amber-400 dark:peer-focus-visible:text-amber-400 peer-focus-visible:ring-2 peer-focus-visible:ring-amber-400 dark:peer-focus-visible:ring-amber-400 " + utils.TransitionColors
}

func pluralStars(n int) string {
	if n == 1 {
		return ""
	}
	return "s"
}

# ── forms/segmented_control.go ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// SegmentedControl component: a single-select segmented button group in two
// zero-JS modes — link mode (server-round-trip filtering, the FilterChips
// sibling with segmented visuals) and radio mode (a native radiogroup that
// submits with its enclosing form, e.g. FilterBar). Extracted from
// dnsblockd's duration/preset button groups and nsfw-classifier's threshold
// presets (2026-10-10 analysis, TODO_LIST #394).
package forms

import (
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// SegmentedControlItem is one option.
type SegmentedControlItem struct {
	// Label is the visible text.
	Label string
	// Value is the option's submitted value (radio mode).
	Value string
	// Href, when set on ANY item, switches the whole control to link mode —
	// every item should carry one (a mixed control is a consumer bug;
	// items without an Href render inert links in link mode).
	Href string
}

// SegmentedControlProps configures a segmented single-select group.
type SegmentedControlProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps

	// Name is the radio group's field name (radio mode). Ignored in link
	// mode.
	Name string
	// Items render in FORWARD DOM order (first item first) so radiogroup
	// arrow keys move down the value order (the Rating rule).
	Items []SegmentedControlItem
	// ActiveValue marks the selected item: the checked radio (radio mode)
	// or aria-current link (link mode).
	ActiveValue string
}

// DefaultSegmentedControlProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultSegmentedControlProps() SegmentedControlProps {
	return SegmentedControlProps{ //nolint:exhaustruct_v5 // no non-zero defaults
		Name: "segment",
	}
}

// segmentedControlIsLinkMode reports whether any item carries an Href.
func segmentedControlIsLinkMode(items []SegmentedControlItem) bool {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Href != "" {
			return true
		}
	}

	return false
}

# ── forms/segmented_control.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"strconv"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// segmentedControlFallbackLabel names a control whose consumer set neither
// AriaLabel nor a visible heading — a radiogroup must never render unnamed.
const segmentedControlFallbackLabel = "Options"

// segmentedControlItemClass is the shared segment style: the label (radio
// mode) or link (link mode) carries the checked/current styling via
// peer-checked (the label is the radio's sibling — the Rating rule).
const segmentedControlItemClass = "cursor-pointer rounded-sm px-3 py-1 text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 transition-colors motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:duration-0 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 peer-checked:bg-blue-600 peer-checked:text-white peer-focus-visible:ring-2 peer-focus-visible:ring-blue-500 peer-focus-visible:outline-none dark:peer-checked:bg-blue-500 dark:peer-focus-visible:ring-blue-400"

// segmentedControlLinkActiveClass is the active link's override in link mode.
const segmentedControlLinkActiveClass = "bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500 dark:text-white dark:hover:bg-blue-400"

// SegmentedControl renders a single-select segmented group.
//
// Link mode (server-round-trip, zero JS):
//
//	@forms.SegmentedControl(forms.SegmentedControlProps{
//		Items: []forms.SegmentedControlItem{
//			{Label: "Strict", Value: "30", Href: "/settings?threshold=30"},
//			{Label: "Balanced", Value: "50", Href: "/settings?threshold=50"},
//		},
//		ActiveValue: "50",
//	})
//
// Radio mode (submits with the enclosing form — e.g. inside FilterBar):
//
//	@forms.SegmentedControl(forms.SegmentedControlProps{
//		Name: "duration",
//		Items: []forms.SegmentedControlItem{
//			{Label: "15m", Value: "15m"},
//			{Label: "1h", Value: "60m"},
//		},
//		ActiveValue: "15m",
//	})
templ SegmentedControl(props SegmentedControlProps) {
	{{
		label := props.AriaLabel
		if label == "" {
			label = segmentedControlFallbackLabel
		}
		groupID := utils.EnsureID("seg", props.ID)
		linkMode := segmentedControlIsLinkMode(props.Items)
	}}
	<div
		id={ groupID }
		class={ utils.Class("inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white p-0.5 dark:border-gray-600 dark:bg-gray-800", props.Class) }
		if linkMode {
			role="group"
		} else {
			role="radiogroup"
		}
		aria-label={ label }
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		for i, item := range props.Items {
			if linkMode {
				<a
					href={ templ.SafeURL(item.Href) }
					class={ utils.Class(segmentedControlItemClass, utils.Ternary(item.Value == props.ActiveValue, segmentedControlLinkActiveClass, ""), "no-underline") }
					if item.Value == props.ActiveValue {
						aria-current="true"
					}
				>
					{ item.Label }
				</a>
			} else {
				<input
					type="radio"
					name={ props.Name }
					value={ item.Value }
					id={ groupID + "-" + strconv.Itoa(i) }
					if item.Value == props.ActiveValue {
						checked
					}
					class="peer sr-only"
				/>
				<label for={ groupID + "-" + strconv.Itoa(i) } class={ segmentedControlItemClass }>{ item.Label }</label>
			}
		}
	</div>
}

# ── forms/select.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// SelectOption represents a single option in a select.
// If both Disabled and Selected are true, Selected is cleared because a
// disabled option cannot be meaningfully pre-selected by the user.
type SelectOption struct {
	Value    string
	Label    string
	Disabled bool
	Selected bool
}

// SelectGroup represents an <optgroup> with a label and its options.
// When SelectProps.Groups is non-empty, options are rendered as optgroups
// instead of a flat list. Use this for logically grouping options (e.g.
// channels by category, cities by country).
type SelectGroup struct {
	Label   string
	Options []SelectOption
}

// normalizeSelectOptions returns a defensive copy of opts with contradictions
// resolved: Disabled+Selected clears Selected, and only the first Selected option
// is kept (a single-value <select> cannot have multiple pre-selected options —
// browsers resolve the ambiguity inconsistently). The caller's slice is never
// mutated, so reusing the same []SelectOption across renders is safe.
func normalizeSelectOptions(opts []SelectOption) []SelectOption {
	out := make([]SelectOption, len(opts))
	copy(out, opts)
	firstSelected := true
	for i := range out {
		if out[i].Disabled && out[i].Selected {
			out[i].Selected = false
			continue
		}
		if out[i].Selected {
			if !firstSelected {
				out[i].Selected = false
			}
			firstSelected = false
		}
	}
	return out
}

// SelectProps configures a select dropdown.
// Set Groups to render <optgroup> elements; Options is ignored when Groups is non-empty.
type SelectProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name    string
	Label   string
	Options []SelectOption
	// Groups, when non-empty, renders <optgroup> elements instead of a flat
	// Options list. Each group has its own label. Options is ignored when
	// Groups is set.
	Groups   []SelectGroup
	Required bool
	Disabled bool
	// Stylable, when true, opts into the modern customizable <select> API
	// (appearance: base-select). Emits a <button><selectedcontent> structure
	// inside the select for CSS styling. Non-supporting browsers ignore
	// these elements — progressive enhancement, no breaking changes.
	// Requires the .tc-select CSS from templates/app.css.
	Stylable bool
	Error    string
	HelpText string
}

// DefaultSelectProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultSelectProps() SelectProps {
	return SelectProps{}
}

// Select renders a labeled select dropdown
//
//	@forms.Select(forms.SelectProps{
//	   Name: "country",
//	   Label: "Country",
//	   Options: []forms.SelectOption{
//	     {Value: "de", Label: "Germany"},
//	     {Value: "at", Label: "Austria"},
//	   },
//	})
//	// Grouped options (renders <optgroup>):
//	//
//	@forms.Select(forms.SelectProps{
//	   Name: "channel",
//	   Label: "Channel",
//	   Groups: []forms.SelectGroup{
//	     {Label: "Text Channels", Options: []forms.SelectOption{
//	       {Value: "general", Label: "#general"},
//	       {Value: "random", Label: "#random"},
//	     }},
//	     {Label: "Voice Channels", Options: []forms.SelectOption{
//	       {Value: "voice-1", Label: "🔊 Lounge"},
//	     }},
//	   },
//	})
templ Select(props SelectProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	@FormFieldWrapper(FormFieldProps{ID: props.ID, Label: props.Label, Required: props.Required, Error: props.Error, HelpText: props.HelpText}) {
		<select
			name={ props.Name }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class(baseInputClass(props.Error != ""), utils.Ternary(props.Stylable, "tc-select", ""), props.Class) }
			if props.Required {
				required
				aria-required="true"
			}
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			if props.Stylable {
				<button><selectedcontent></selectedcontent></button>
			}
			if len(props.Groups) > 0 {
				for _, grp := range props.Groups {
					{{ opts := normalizeSelectOptions(grp.Options) }}
					<optgroup label={ grp.Label }>
						for _, opt := range opts {
							<option
								value={ opt.Value }
								if opt.Disabled {
									disabled
								}
								if opt.Selected {
									selected
								}
							>
								{ opt.Label }
							</option>
						}
					</optgroup>
				}
			} else {
				{{ options := normalizeSelectOptions(props.Options) }}
				for _, opt := range options {
					<option
						value={ opt.Value }
						if opt.Disabled {
							disabled
						}
						if opt.Selected {
							selected
						}
					>
						{ opt.Label }
					</option>
				}
			}
		</select>
	}
}

# ── forms/slider.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// SliderProps configures a range input slider.
type SliderProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name     string
	Label    string
	Min      float64
	Max      float64
	Value    float64
	Step     float64
	Required bool
	Disabled bool
	HelpText string
	Error    string
	// ShowValue displays the current value next to the label.
	ShowValue bool
}

// DefaultSliderProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultSliderProps() SliderProps {
	return SliderProps{
		Min:  0,
		Max:  100,
		Step: 1,
	}
}

// sliderInputClass returns the Tailwind classes for the range input. The
// INPUT box is h-6 so the hit target clears the WCAG 2.2 24px minimum
// (M21/F097 audit caught an 8px target); the visual track stays 8px via the
// engine track pseudo-elements, and the thumb keeps its accent-color
// rendering (Chromium/Firefox both apply accent-color under
// appearance:none — browser-verified by the routes visual goldens).
func sliderInputClass() string {
	return "w-full h-6 appearance-none cursor-pointer bg-transparent accent-blue-600 dark:accent-blue-400 " +
		"focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 dark:focus-visible:ring-blue-500 " +
		"disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed " +
		"[&::-webkit-slider-runnable-track]:h-2 [&::-webkit-slider-runnable-track]:rounded-lg " +
		"[&::-webkit-slider-runnable-track]:bg-gray-200 dark:[&::-webkit-slider-runnable-track]:bg-gray-700 " +
		"[&::-moz-range-track]:h-2 [&::-moz-range-track]:rounded-lg " +
		"[&::-moz-range-track]:bg-gray-200 dark:[&::-moz-range-track]:bg-gray-700"
}

// Slider renders a labeled range input with accessible labeling.
//
//	@forms.Slider(forms.SliderProps{
//	   Name:  "volume",
//	   Label: "Volume",
//	   Min:   0,
//	   Max:   100,
//	   Value: 50,
//	   Step:  5,
//	})
templ Slider(props SliderProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	{{
		step := props.Step
		if step == 0 {
			step = 1
		}
	}}
	<div class={ utils.Class("space-y-1", props.Class) } { props.Attrs... }>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
				<label
					if props.ID != "" {
						for={ props.ID }
					}
					class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
				>
					{ props.Label }
					if props.Required {
						<span class="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 ms-0.5" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
					}
				</label>
				if props.ShowValue {
					<span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400" data-slider-value>{ fmt.Sprintf("%g", props.Value) }</span>
				}
			</div>
		}
		<input
			type="range"
			name={ props.Name }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			min={ fmt.Sprintf("%g", props.Min) }
			max={ fmt.Sprintf("%g", props.Max) }
			value={ fmt.Sprintf("%g", props.Value) }
			step={ fmt.Sprintf("%g", step) }
			class={ sliderInputClass() }
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if props.Required {
				required
			}
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
			{ props.Attrs... }
		/>
		if props.Error != "" {
			@FieldError(props.ID, props.Error)
		}
		if props.HelpText != "" {
			@helpText(props.ID, props.HelpText)
		}
	</div>
}

# ── forms/tags_input.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// TagsInputProps configures a tag input where users can add and remove tags.
// Tags are rendered as removable badges. Values are submitted as repeated
// hidden inputs with the given Name, so the server receives []string.
type TagsInputProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name           string
	Label          string
	Values         []string
	Placeholder    string
	MaxTags        int  // 0 = unlimited
	AllowDuplicate bool // false by default
	Required       bool
	Disabled       bool
	Error          string
	HelpText       string
}

// DefaultTagsInputProps returns sensible defaults.
func DefaultTagsInputProps() TagsInputProps {
	return TagsInputProps{} //nolint:exhaustruct // intentionally minimal
}

// tagsInputFallbackName is the accessible name for the TagsInput text field
// when the consumer set neither Label nor AriaLabel — a text input must never
// render unnamed (axe label).
const tagsInputFallbackName = "Add tag"

// tagsInputRemoveIconPath sources the remove-tag X glyph from the icons
// package's single source of truth (icons.X) for JS injection.
func tagsInputRemoveIconPath() string {
	return icons.IconPathData(icons.X)[0]
}

// tagsInputJS is the CSP-safe add/remove singleton script (ADR-0005); %s is
// the icons-sourced X path data.
const tagsInputJS = `
				(function(){if(window.tcTagsInputAttached)return;window.tcTagsInputAttached=true;
				document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
				var input=e.target;if(!input||!input.hasAttribute('data-tc-tags-input'))return;
				var container=input.closest('[data-tc-tags]');if(!container)return;
				if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===','){e.preventDefault();
				var val=input.value.trim();if(!val)return;input.value='';
				var existing=container.querySelectorAll('[data-tc-tag]');
				if(!container.dataset.allowDuplicate){for(var i=0;i<existing.length;i++){if(existing[i].getAttribute('data-tc-tag')===val)return;}}
				var max=parseInt(container.dataset.maxTags||'0',10);if(max>0&&existing.length>=max)return;
				var span=document.createElement('span');span.className='inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/50 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300';span.setAttribute('data-tc-tag',val);span.textContent=val+' ';
				var btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.className='p-1.5 -m-1.5 text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 dark:hover:text-blue-200';btn.setAttribute('data-tc-tag-remove',val);btn.setAttribute('aria-label','Remove '+val);btn.innerHTML='<svg class="h-3 w-3" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="%s"></path></svg>';
				span.appendChild(btn);
				var hidden=document.createElement('input');hidden.type='hidden';hidden.name=container.getAttribute('data-tc-tags');hidden.value=val;
				container.insertBefore(span,input);container.insertBefore(hidden,input);}
				if(e.key==='Backspace'&&input.value===''){var tags=container.querySelectorAll('[data-tc-tag]');if(tags.length>0){var last=tags[tags.length-1];var v=last.getAttribute('data-tc-tag');last.remove();var hs=container.querySelectorAll('input[type=hidden][value="'+v+'"]');for(var j=0;j<hs.length;j++){hs[j].remove();}}}});
				document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var btn=e.target.closest('[data-tc-tag-remove]');if(!btn)return;e.preventDefault();var container=btn.closest('[data-tc-tags]');if(!container)return;var v=btn.getAttribute('data-tc-tag-remove');var tag=btn.closest('[data-tc-tag]');if(tag)tag.remove();var hs=container.querySelectorAll('input[type=hidden][value="'+v+'"]');for(var k=0;k<hs.length;k++){hs[k].remove();}});
				})();
			`

// tagsInputScriptComponent writes the tags-input script raw: templ's <script>
// context sanitizes interpolations, and the JS must land verbatim with the
// icons-sourced path data (same pattern as dirtyGuardScriptComponent). The
// script itself always renders so non-CSP consumers still get working tags;
// utils.ScriptComponent owns the omit-empty nonce rule and the CSP-safe
// write (nonce="" is rejected by strict-CSP pages — see utils.ScriptAttrs).
func tagsInputScriptComponent(nonce string) templ.Component {
	script := fmt.Sprintf(tagsInputJS, tagsInputRemoveIconPath())

	return utils.ScriptComponent(nonce, script, "tags input script")
}

// tagsInputContainerClass returns the container classes for the tags input.
func tagsInputContainerClass(hasError bool) string {
	base := "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 px-3 py-2 border-0 ring-1 ring-inset focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-inset transition-shadow motion-reduce:transition-none"
	if hasError {
		return base + " ring-red-300 dark:ring-red-700 focus-within:ring-red-500 dark:focus-within:ring-red-500"
	}
	return base + " ring-gray-300 dark:ring-gray-600 focus-within:ring-blue-600 dark:focus-within:ring-blue-500"
}

// TagsInput renders a tag input with add/remove functionality.
// Tags are submitted as repeated hidden inputs. A CSP-safe singleton script
// handles Enter-to-add, Backspace-to-delete-last, and remove-button clicks.
//
//	@forms.TagsInput(forms.TagsInputProps{
//	   Name:  "skills",
//	   Label: "Skills",
//	   Values: []string{"Go", "HTMX"},
//	   Placeholder: "Add a skill...",
//	})
templ TagsInput(props TagsInputProps) {
	{{ id := utils.EnsureID("tags", props.ID) }}
	<div class={ utils.Class("space-y-1", props.Class) } { props.Attrs... }>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<label
				for={ id }
				class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
			>
				{ props.Label }
				if props.Required {
					<span class="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 ms-0.5" aria-hidden="true">*</span>
				}
			</label>
		}
		<div
			class={ tagsInputContainerClass(props.Error != "") }
			data-tc-tags={ id }
			if props.MaxTags > 0 {
				data-max-tags={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.MaxTags) }
			}
			if props.AllowDuplicate {
				data-allow-duplicate="true"
			}
		>
			for _, val := range props.Values {
				<span
					class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/50 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300"
					data-tc-tag={ val }
				>
					{ val }
					<button
						type="button"
						class="p-1.5 -m-1.5 text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 dark:hover:text-blue-200"
						aria-label={ "Remove " + val }
						data-tc-tag-remove={ val }
					>
						@icons.IconWithStrokeWidth(icons.X, "h-3 w-3", 2)
					</button>
				</span>
				<input type="hidden" name={ props.Name } value={ val }/>
			}
			<input
				type="text"
				id={ id }
				class="flex-1 min-w-[120px] bg-transparent border-0 outline-none py-1 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:placeholder:text-gray-500 caret-blue-600 dark:caret-blue-400"
				placeholder={ props.Placeholder }
				if props.Disabled {
					disabled
				}
				if props.Required {
					required
				}
				aria-label={ utils.Ternary(props.AriaLabel != "", props.AriaLabel, utils.Ternary(props.Label != "", props.Label, tagsInputFallbackName)) }
				data-tc-tags-input
				{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
				{ props.Attrs... }
			/>
		</div>
		if props.Error != "" {
			@FieldError(props.ID, props.Error)
		}
		if props.HelpText != "" {
			@helpText(props.ID, props.HelpText)
		}
		@tagsInputScriptComponent(props.Nonce)
	</div>
}

# ── forms/textarea.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// EnterKeyHintType defines valid HTML enterkeyhint values for the mobile
// keyboard Enter key label. See:
// https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/enterkeyhint
type EnterKeyHintType string

const (
	EnterKeyHintEnter    EnterKeyHintType = "enter"
	EnterKeyHintDone     EnterKeyHintType = "done"
	EnterKeyHintGo       EnterKeyHintType = "go"
	EnterKeyHintNext     EnterKeyHintType = "next"
	EnterKeyHintPrevious EnterKeyHintType = "previous"
	EnterKeyHintSearch   EnterKeyHintType = "search"
	EnterKeyHintSend     EnterKeyHintType = "send"
)

//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level validation set for enterkeyhint
var validEnterKeyHints = map[EnterKeyHintType]bool{
	EnterKeyHintEnter: true, EnterKeyHintDone: true, EnterKeyHintGo: true,
	EnterKeyHintNext: true, EnterKeyHintPrevious: true,
	EnterKeyHintSearch: true, EnterKeyHintSend: true,
}

// EnterKeyHintTypeIsValid returns true if v is a recognized enterkeyhint value.
func EnterKeyHintTypeIsValid(v EnterKeyHintType) bool { return validEnterKeyHints[v] }

// TextareaProps configures a textarea. AutoGrow (default true) uses the
// modern CSS field-sizing: content property to grow the textarea to fit its
// content without JavaScript. EnterKeyHint sets the mobile keyboard's Enter
// key label (e.g. "send" for chat, "done", "go", "next", "previous", "search").
type TextareaProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name         string
	Value        string
	Placeholder  string
	Label        string
	Rows         int
	Required     bool
	Disabled     bool
	ReadOnly     bool
	MaxLength    int
	AutoGrow     bool
	EnterKeyHint EnterKeyHintType
	Error        string
	HelpText     string
}

// DefaultTextareaProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultTextareaProps() TextareaProps {
	return TextareaProps{
		Rows:     4,
		AutoGrow: true,
	}
}

// Textarea renders a labeled textarea
//
//	@forms.Textarea(forms.TextareaProps{
//	   Name: "bio",
//	   Label: "Bio",
//	   Rows: 4,
//	   Placeholder: "Tell us about yourself...",
//	})
templ Textarea(props TextareaProps) {
	{{ props.ID = fieldID(props.ID, props.Name) }}
	@FormFieldWrapper(FormFieldProps{ID: props.ID, Label: props.Label, Required: props.Required, Error: props.Error, HelpText: props.HelpText}) {
		<textarea
			name={ props.Name }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			if props.Placeholder != "" {
				placeholder={ props.Placeholder }
			}
			if props.Rows > 0 {
				rows={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.Rows) }
			} else {
				rows="4"
			}
			class={ utils.Class(baseInputClass(props.Error != ""), utils.Ternary(props.AutoGrow, "field-sizing-content min-h-10 max-h-80", ""), props.Class) }
			if props.EnterKeyHint != "" {
				enterkeyhint={ props.EnterKeyHint }
			}
			if props.Required {
				required
				aria-required="true"
			}
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if props.ReadOnly {
				readonly
			}
			if props.MaxLength > 0 {
				maxlength={ fmt.Sprintf("%d", props.MaxLength) }
			}
			{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			{ props.Value }
		</textarea>
	}
}

# ── forms/toggle.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// ToggleSize defines the size of a toggle switch
type ToggleSize string

const (
	ToggleSizeSM ToggleSize = "sm"
	ToggleSizeMD ToggleSize = "md"
	ToggleSizeLG ToggleSize = "lg"
)

// ToggleProps configures a toggle/switch input
type ToggleProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Name     string
	Label    string
	Checked  bool
	Disabled bool
	Required bool
	Error    string
	HelpText string
	Size     ToggleSize
}

// DefaultToggleProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultToggleProps() ToggleProps {
	return ToggleProps{
		Size: ToggleSizeMD,
	}
}

// toggleSizeClasses returns the track, thumb, and checked-state move classes for each size
func toggleSizeClasses(size ToggleSize) (track, thumb, move string) {
	s := toggleSizeLookup(size)
	return s.Track, s.Thumb, s.Move
}

type toggleSizeSet struct {
	Track, Thumb, Move string
}

// Move values include the complete "peer-checked:*:" variant prefix as a
// literal so Tailwind's content scanner can detect them. Concatenating the
// variant at runtime ("peer-checked:" + x) produces an invisible token that
// the scanner never finds, so the generated CSS omits the class and the thumb
// does not slide.
//
// The move class is applied to the TRACK, not the thumb: Tailwind's
// peer-checked variant compiles to ":is(:where(.peer):checked ~ *)", which
// only matches SIBLINGS of the peer input. The thumb is nested inside the
// track, so a peer-checked class on the thumb itself can never match (the
// circle never moved). The "*" child variant reaches it:
// peer-checked:*:inset-s-N compiles to "sibling-of-checked-peer > *".
//
// The thumb moves via inset-inline-start (logical), not translate-x
// (physical): the unchecked thumb rests at inset-s-0.5, so checked must set
// the checked position 0.125rem from the inline edge
// (track − thumb − 2×0.125rem, in spacing units: 4.5/5.5/6.5). translate-x
// is physical and would push the thumb off the track's leading edge in RTL;
// inset-inline-start mirrors with dir="rtl" in both rest and checked states.
// The thumb animates its inline-start inset (CSS transition on that property).
//
//nolint:gochecknoglobals // Package-level lookup table for toggle sizes.
var toggleSizeMap = map[ToggleSize]toggleSizeSet{
	ToggleSizeSM: {"w-9 h-5", "w-4 h-4", "peer-checked:*:inset-s-4.5"},
	ToggleSizeLG: {"w-14 h-8", "w-7 h-7", "peer-checked:*:inset-s-6.5"},
}

var toggleSizeDefault = toggleSizeSet{"w-11 h-6", "w-5 h-5", "peer-checked:*:inset-s-5.5"}

func toggleSizeLookup(size ToggleSize) toggleSizeSet {
	return utils.Lookup(toggleSizeMap, size, toggleSizeDefault)
}

// Toggle renders an accessible toggle switch
// Uses a visually-hidden checkbox for native form submission and accessibility.
//
//	@forms.Toggle(forms.ToggleProps{Name: "notifications", Label: "Enable notifications", Checked: true})
templ Toggle(props ToggleProps) {
	{{ trackClass, thumbClass, moveClass := toggleSizeClasses(props.Size) }}
	<label
		class={ utils.Class("flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center", utils.Ternary(props.Disabled, "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed", "cursor-pointer"), props.Class) }
		if props.AriaLabel != "" {
			aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
		}
		{ props.Attrs... }
	>
		<input
			type="checkbox"
			name={ props.Name }
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class="peer sr-only"
			if props.Checked {
				checked
			}
			if props.Disabled {
				disabled
			}
			if props.Required {
				required
				aria-required="true"
			}
			{ ErrorAttrs(props.ID, props.Error, utils.Ternary(props.HelpText != "", HelpTextID(props.ID), ""))... }
		/>
		<span class={ utils.Class("relative rounded-full bg-gray-200 transition-colors peer-checked:bg-blue-600 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:peer-checked:bg-blue-500 motion-reduce:transition-none", trackClass, moveClass) }>
			<span class={ utils.Class("absolute top-0.5 inset-s-0.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-[inset-inline-start] motion-reduce:transition-none", thumbClass) }></span>
		</span>
		if props.Label != "" {
			<span class="ms-3 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{ props.Label }</span>
		}
	</label>
	@FieldError(props.ID, props.Error)
	if props.HelpText != "" {
		@helpText(props.ID, props.HelpText)
	}
}

# ── forms/validation.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package forms

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/icons"
	"github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"
)

// FieldError represents a single field validation error
type ValidationError struct {
	Field   string // HTML element ID (e.g. "email", "user_name") — used as the anchor href target
	Message string
}

// ValidationSummaryProps configures a form validation error summary
type ValidationSummaryProps struct {
	utils.BaseProps
	Errors []ValidationError
}

// DefaultValidationSummaryProps returns sensible defaults
func DefaultValidationSummaryProps() ValidationSummaryProps {
	return ValidationSummaryProps{}
}

// ValidationSummary renders an accessible error summary for form validation
//
//	@forms.ValidationSummary(forms.ValidationSummaryProps{
//	   Errors: []forms.ValidationError{
//	     {Field: "email", Message: "Email is required"},
//	     {Field: "name", Message: "Name must be at least 2 characters"},
//	   },
//	})
templ ValidationSummary(props ValidationSummaryProps) {
	if len(props.Errors) > 0 {
		<div
			if props.ID != "" {
				id={ props.ID }
			}
			class={ utils.Class("rounded-md bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/30 p-4 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800", props.Class) }
			role="alert"
			if props.AriaLabel != "" {
				aria-label={ props.AriaLabel }
			}
			{ props.Attrs... }
		>
			<div class="flex">
				<div class="flex-shrink-0">
					@icons.Icon(icons.ExclamationCircle, "h-5 w-5 text-red-400 dark:text-red-500")
				</div>
				<div class="ms-3">
					<h3 class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 dark:text-red-300">
						{ fmt.Sprintf("%d error%s found", len(props.Errors), utils.Ternary(len(props.Errors) == 1, "", "s")) }
					</h3>
					<div class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-400">
						<ul class="list-disc space-y-1 ps-5">
							for _, err := range props.Errors {
								<li>
									if err.Field != "" {
										<a href={ "#" + err.Field } class="text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 underline hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-300">{ err.Message }</a>
									} else {
										{ err.Message }
									}
								</li>
							}
						</ul>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	}
}

# ── layout/appshell.templ ─────────────────────────────────────────────
package layout

import "github.com/larsartmann/templ-components/utils"

// appshellShellClasses maps the hamburger breakpoint to the outer grid
// wrapper for shells WITH a sidebar. Complete literals per breakpoint —
// Tailwind's scanner must find every variant; never concatenate prefixes.
// min-h-dvh ensures the shell fills the viewport height; the grid is
// breakpoint-gated so mobile collapses to a single column (sidebar hidden,
// content full-width). BELOW the breakpoint the shell is `flex flex-col`
// — that is what stretches the content column (with its flex-1) to the
// viewport so the Footer slot's mt-auto pins the footer to the bottom at
// every viewport, not only at the grid breakpoint. The main column uses
// minmax(0, 1fr) — never bare 1fr — to prevent grid blowout when a wide
// <table>, long URL, or <pre> lives in the content (see ADR-0016).
var appshellShellClasses = map[AppShellBreakpoint]string{
	AppShellBreakpointUnspecified: "flex flex-col min-h-dvh lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[var(--tc-sidebar-w)_minmax(0,1fr)]",
	AppShellBreakpointMD:          "flex flex-col min-h-dvh md:grid md:grid-cols-[var(--tc-sidebar-w)_minmax(0,1fr)]",
	AppShellBreakpointLG:          "flex flex-col min-h-dvh lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[var(--tc-sidebar-w)_minmax(0,1fr)]",
	AppShellBreakpointXL:          "flex flex-col min-h-dvh xl:grid xl:grid-cols-[var(--tc-sidebar-w)_minmax(0,1fr)]",
}

// appshellShellNoSidebarClass is the outer wrapper class when no Sidebar slot
// is provided. The two-track grid template MUST NOT be emitted in that case:
// with a single child it would place the content column into the
// sidebar-width track, leaving the second track empty and collapsing the
// whole shell to the sidebar width. The flex column + min-h-dvh keeps the
// Footer slot's mt-auto sticky-footer working without a sidebar too.
const appshellShellNoSidebarClass = "flex flex-col min-h-dvh"

// appshellSidebarWrapperClasses hide the sidebar below the breakpoint so it
// doesn't take up mobile real estate. The sidebar slot itself (e.g.
// SidebarNav) renders its own <aside>; this wrapper is a positioning shell
// only.
var appshellSidebarWrapperClasses = map[AppShellBreakpoint]string{
	AppShellBreakpointUnspecified: "hidden lg:block",
	AppShellBreakpointMD:          "hidden md:block",
	AppShellBreakpointLG:          "hidden lg:block",
